sentences.zh: 志第六 五行三

translations.literal: Treatise 6, Five Elements 3.
translations.idiomatic: Treatise on the Five Elements, Part Three.

translations.literal: Section marker (opening bracket in source).
translations.idiomatic: Metal and Earth

sentences.zh: （金 土）〉

translations.literal: (Metal, Earth)〉
translations.idiomatic: (Metal and Earth sections).

sentences.zh: 《洪範》曰：「金曰從革。

translations.literal: The Hong Fan says: "Metal is called complying and transforming."
translations.idiomatic: The Hong Fan states: "Metal is defined as complying and transforming (conforming and changing)."

sentences.zh: 」金不從革，則失其性矣。

translations.literal: When metal does not comply and transform, it loses its nature.
translations.idiomatic: When metal neither conforms nor changes, it has forsaken its proper nature.

sentences.zh: 前史多以恆暘、詩妖、毛蟲之孽、犬禍、金石之妖、白眚白祥皆屬之金，今從之。

translations.literal: Earlier histories mostly classified persistent yang, poetic anomalies, hair-insect calamities, dog portents, metal-and-stone anomalies, white afflictions and white omens all under metal; this follows them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier dynastic histories grouped persistent drought-yang, poetic anomalies, calamities among hairy insects, dog portents, anomalies in metal and stone, and white afflictions and white auspices under the element Metal; this chapter follows that convention.

sentences.zh: ▲恆蝪

translations.literal: ▲ Persistent drought (恆蝪 in source)
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Persistent Drought

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，夏旱。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 3, summer: drought.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 3, summer: drought.

sentences.zh: 六月戊午朔，步禱郊壇。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon of day wuwu: paced prayer at the suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 3, sixth month, new moon of day wuwu: the court performed paced prayers at the suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 四年，陝西、河南、山西及直隸常州、臨濠、北平、河間、永平旱。

translations.literal: Year 4: Shaanxi, Henan, Shanxi, and Zhili's Changzhou, Linhao, Beiping, Hejian, and Yongping had drought.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 4: drought struck Shaanxi, Henan, Shanxi, and in Zhili the prefectures of Changzhou, Linhao, Beiping, Hejian, and Yongping.

sentences.zh: 五年夏，山東旱。

translations.literal: Year 5, summer: Shandong drought.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 5, summer: Shandong suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 七年夏，北平旱。

translations.literal: Year 7, summer: Beiping drought.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 7, summer: Beiping had drought.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，山東旱。

translations.literal: Year 23: Shandong drought.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 23: Shandong had drought.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，大旱，詔求直言。

translations.literal: Year 26: great drought; an edict sought forthright counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 26: a great drought prompted an edict calling for forthright remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 永樂十三年，鳳陽、蘇州、浙江、湖廣旱。

translations.literal: Yongle year 13: Fengyang, Suzhou, Zhejiang, and Huguang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 13: drought afflicted Fengyang, Suzhou, Zhejiang, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十六年，陝西旱。

translations.literal: Year 16: Shaanxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 16: Shaanxi had drought.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年夏，江西旱。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, summer: Jiangxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, summer: Jiangxi suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 湖廣夏秋旱。

translations.literal: Huguang drought in summer and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1: Huguang had drought through summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 二年，南畿、湖廣、山東、山西、陝西、河南旱。

translations.literal: Year 2: the Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Henan drought.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 2: drought spread across the Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 七年，河南及大名夏秋旱。

translations.literal: Year 7: Henan and Daming drought in summer and autumn.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 7: Henan and Daming had summer and autumn drought.

sentences.zh: 八年，南、北畿、河南、山東、山西自春徂夏不雨。

translations.literal: Year 8: the southern and northern metropolitan regions, Henan, Shandong, and Shanxi had no rain from spring through summer.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 8: from spring into summer the southern and northern metropolitan regions plus Henan, Shandong, and Shanxi went without rain.

sentences.zh: 九年，南畿、湖廣、江西、浙江及真定、濟南、東昌、兗州、平陽、重慶等府旱。

translations.literal: Year 9: the Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and the prefectures Zhending, Jinan, Dongchang, Yanzhou, Pingyang, Chongqing, and others drought.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 9: drought hit the Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, and prefectures including Zhending, Jinan, Dongchang, Yanzhou, Pingyang, and Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 十年，畿輔旱。

translations.literal: Year 10: the metropolitan region drought.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 10: the capital region had drought.

sentences.zh: 正統二年，河南春旱。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 2: Henan spring drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2: Henan had spring drought.

sentences.zh: 順德、兗州春夏旱。

translations.literal: Shunde and Yanzhou spring and summer drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2: Shunde and Yanzhou suffered drought through spring and summer.

sentences.zh: 平涼等六府秋旱。

translations.literal: Pingliang and five other prefectures autumn drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2: Pingliang and five other prefectures had autumn drought.

sentences.zh: 三年，南畿、浙江、湖廣、江西九府旱。

translations.literal: Year 3: the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Huguang, and nine Jiangxi prefectures drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 3: drought struck the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Huguang, and nine prefectures of Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 四年，直隸、陝西、河南及太原、平陽春夏旱。

translations.literal: Year 4: Zhili, Shaanxi, Henan, and Taiyuan and Pingyang spring and summer drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 4: Zhili, Shaanxi, Henan, Taiyuan, and Pingyang had spring and summer drought.

sentences.zh: 五年，江西夏秋旱。

translations.literal: Year 5: Jiangxi summer and autumn drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 5: Jiangxi suffered drought through summer and autumn.

sentences.zh: 南畿、湖廣、四川府五，州衛各一，自六月不雨至於八月。

translations.literal: The Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, and five Sichuan prefectures, one prefecture and one guard each, had no rain from the sixth month through the eighth.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 5: in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, five Sichuan prefectures, and one prefecture and one guard apiece elsewhere, rain failed from the sixth month through the eighth.

sentences.zh: 六年，陝西旱。

translations.literal: Year 6: Shaanxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 6: Shaanxi had drought.

sentences.zh: 南畿、浙江、湖廣、江西府州縣十五，春夏並旱。

translations.literal: Fifteen prefectures, departments, and counties in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi had drought together in spring and summer.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 6: spring and summer drought together afflicted fifteen prefectures, departments, and counties across the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 七年，南畿、浙江、湖廣、江西府州縣衛二十餘，大旱。

translations.literal: Year 7: more than twenty prefectures, departments, counties, and guards in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 7: a great drought gripped more than twenty prefectures, departments, counties, and guards in the Southern Metropolitan Region, Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十年夏，湖廣旱。

translations.literal: Year 10, summer: Huguang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 10, summer: Huguang had drought.

sentences.zh: 十一年，湖廣及重慶等府夏秋旱。

translations.literal: Year 11: Huguang and the prefectures of Chongqing and others summer and autumn drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 11: Huguang and prefectures including Chongqing suffered summer and autumn drought.

sentences.zh: 十二年，南畿及山西、湖廣等府七夏旱。

translations.literal: Year 12: the Southern Metropolitan Region and seven prefectures including Shanxi and Huguang summer drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 12, summer: drought hit the Southern Metropolitan Region and seven prefectures among Shanxi, Huguang, and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 十三年，直隸、陝西、湖廣府州七夏秋旱。

translations.literal: Year 13: seven prefectures and departments in Zhili, Shaanxi, and Huguang summer and autumn drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 13: seven prefectures and departments in Zhili, Shaanxi, and Huguang had summer and autumn drought.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月，順天、保定、河間、真定旱。

translations.literal: Year 14, sixth month: Shuntian, Baoding, Hejian, and Zhending drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 14, sixth month: drought at Shuntian, Baoding, Hejian, and Zhending.

sentences.zh: 成化三年，湖廣、江西及南京十一衛旱。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 3: Huguang, Jiangxi, and eleven Nanjing guards drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 3: drought afflicted Huguang, Jiangxi, and eleven Nanjing guards.

sentences.zh: 四年，兩京春夏不雨。

translations.literal: Year 4: the two capitals had no rain in spring and summer.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 4: spring and summer passed at both capitals without rain.

sentences.zh: 湖廣、江西旱。

translations.literal: Huguang and Jiangxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 4: Huguang and Jiangxi also had drought.

sentences.zh: 六年，直隸、山東、河南、陝西、四川府縣衛多旱。

translations.literal: Year 6: many prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhili, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and Sichuan drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 6: drought was widespread across prefectures, counties, and guards in Zhili, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 八年，京畿連月不雨，運河水涸，順德、真定、武昌俱旱。

translations.literal: Year 8: the capital region had no rain for successive months; the Grand Canal's water dried up; Shunde, Zhending, and Wuchang all drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 8: months without rain in the capital region dried the Grand Canal; Shunde, Zhending, and Wuchang all suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 九年，彰德、衛輝、平陽旱。

translations.literal: Year 9: Zhangde, Weihui, and Pingyang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 9: drought at Zhangde, Weihui, and Pingyang.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月，京師旱。

translations.literal: Year 13, fourth month: the capital drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 13, fourth month: drought in the capital.

sentences.zh: 是歲，真定、河間、長沙皆旱。

translations.literal: That year Zhending, Hejian, and Changsha all drought.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Zhending, Hejian, and Changsha all had drought.

sentences.zh: 十五年，京畿大旱，順德、鳳陽、徐州、濟南、河南、湖廣皆旱。

translations.literal: Year 15: great drought in the capital region; Shunde, Fengyang, Xuzhou, Jinan, Henan, and Huguang all drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 15: a great drought in the capital region extended to Shunde, Fengyang, Xuzhou, Jinan, Henan, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十八年，兩京、湖廣、河南、陝西府十五、州二旱。

translations.literal: Year 18: the two capitals, Huguang, Henan, and Shaanxi—fifteen prefectures and two departments—drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 18: drought struck the two capitals, Huguang, Henan, and Shaanxi, fifteen prefectures, and two departments.

sentences.zh: 山西大旱。

translations.literal: Shanxi great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 18: Shanxi suffered a great drought.

sentences.zh: 十九年，復旱。

translations.literal: Year 19: drought again.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 19: drought returned.

sentences.zh: 二十年，京畿、山東、湖廣、陝西、河南、山西俱大旱。

translations.literal: Year 20: the capital region, Shandong, Huguang, Shaanxi, Henan, and Shanxi all had great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 20: a great drought gripped the capital region, Shandong, Huguang, Shaanxi, Henan, and Shanxi together.

sentences.zh: 二十二年六月，陝西旱，蟲鼠食苗稼，凡九十五州縣。

translations.literal: Year 22, sixth month: Shaanxi drought; insects and rodents ate the seedlings and grain; altogether ninety-five prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 22, sixth month: Shaanxi drought brought insects and rodents that devoured seedlings and grain in ninety-five prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 八月，北畿及江西三府旱。

translations.literal: Eighth month: the Northern Metropolitan Region and three Jiangxi prefectures drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 22, eighth month: drought in the Northern Metropolitan Region and three Jiangxi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 九月，溫、臺大旱，長沙諸府亦旱。

translations.literal: Ninth month: Wenzhou and Taizhou great drought; the prefectures of Changsha also drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 22, ninth month: a great drought at Wenzhou and Taizhou; the Changsha prefectures also had drought.

sentences.zh: 正德元年，陝西三府旱。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1: three Shaanxi prefectures drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1: three prefectures in Shaanxi had drought.

sentences.zh: 二年，貴州、山西旱。

translations.literal: Year 2: Guizhou and Shanxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 2: Guizhou and Shanxi suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 三年，江南、北旱。

translations.literal: Year 3: drought south and north of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 3: drought afflicted both Jiangnan and the north.

sentences.zh: 四年，旱，自三月至七月，陝西亦旱。

translations.literal: Year 4: drought from the third month through the seventh; Shaanxi also drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 4: drought from the third month through the seventh; Shaanxi was drought-stricken as well.

sentences.zh: 七年，鳳陽、蘇、鬆、常、鎮、平陽、太原、臨、鞏旱。

translations.literal: Year 7: Fengyang, Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Lintao, and Gongchang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 7: drought at Fengyang, Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, Zhenjiang, Pingyang, Taiyuan, Lintao, and Gongchang.

sentences.zh: 八年，畿輔及開封、大同、浙江六縣旱。

translations.literal: Year 8: the metropolitan region and Kaifeng, Datong, and six Zhejiang counties drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 8: drought in the capital region, Kaifeng, Datong, and six counties of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 九年，順天、河間、保定、廬、鳳、淮、揚旱。

translations.literal: Year 9: Shuntian, Hejian, Baoding, Luzhou, Fengyang, Huai'an, and Yangzhou drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 9: drought struck Shuntian, Hejian, Baoding, Luzhou, Fengyang, Huai'an, and Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 十一年，北畿及兗州、西安、大同旱。

translations.literal: Year 11: the Northern Metropolitan Region and Yanzhou, Xi'an, and Datong drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 11: the Northern Metropolitan Region plus Yanzhou, Xi'an, and Datong had drought.

sentences.zh: 十五年，淮、揚、鳳陽州縣三十六及臨、鞏、甘州旱。

translations.literal: Year 15: thirty-six prefectures and counties in Huai'an and Yangzhou and Fengyang, plus Lintao, Gongchang, and Ganzhou drought.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 15: drought afflicted thirty-six prefectures and counties in Huai'an, Yangzhou, and Fengyang, and also Lintao, Gongchang, and Ganzhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年，兩京、山東、河南、山西、陝西自正月不雨至於六月。

translations.literal: Year 16: the two capitals, Shandong, Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi had no rain from the first month through the sixth.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 16: from the first month through the sixth the two capitals, Shandong, Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi went without rain.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年，南畿、江西、浙江、湖廣、四川、遼東旱。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 1: the Southern Metropolitan Region, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, Sichuan, and Liaodong drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 1: drought spread across the Southern Metropolitan Region, Jiangxi, Zhejiang, Huguang, Sichuan, and Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 二年，兩京、山東、河南、湖廣、江西及嘉興、大同、成都俱旱，赤地千里，殍殣載道。

translations.literal: Year 2: the two capitals, Shandong, Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, and Jiaxing, Datong, and Chengdu all drought; red earth for a thousand li; corpses of the starved filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 2: the two capitals, Shandong, Henan, Huguang, Jiangxi, Jiaxing, Datong, and Chengdu all suffered drought until the land lay bare for a thousand li and corpses of the starved choked the roads.

sentences.zh: 三年，山東旱。

translations.literal: Year 3: Shandong drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 3: Shandong had drought.

sentences.zh: 五年，江左大旱。

translations.literal: Year 5: great drought in the lands south of the Yangtze.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 5: a great drought struck the lands south of the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 六年，北畿四府，河南、山西及鳳陽、淮安俱旱。

translations.literal: Year 6: four prefectures in the Northern Metropolitan Region, Henan, Shanxi, and Fengyang and Huai'an all drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 6: drought hit four Northern Metropolitan prefectures plus Henan, Shanxi, Fengyang, and Huai'an.

sentences.zh: 七年，北畿、湖廣、河南、山東、山西、陝西大旱。

translations.literal: Year 7: the Northern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 7: a great drought gripped the Northern Metropolitan Region, Huguang, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 八年，山西及臨洮、鞏昌旱。

translations.literal: Year 8: Shanxi and Lintao and Gongchang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 8: Shanxi, Lintao, and Gongchang had drought.

sentences.zh: 九年，應天、蘇、鬆旱。

translations.literal: Year 9: Yingtian, Suzhou, and Songjiang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 9: drought at Yingtian, Suzhou, and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 十年，陝西、山西大旱。

translations.literal: Year 10: Shaanxi and Shanxi great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 10: Shaanxi and Shanxi suffered a great drought.

sentences.zh: 十一年，湖廣、陝西大旱。

translations.literal: Year 11: Huguang and Shaanxi great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 11: a great drought afflicted Huguang and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏，兩京、山東、陝西、福建、湖廣大旱。

translations.literal: Year 17, summer: the two capitals, Shandong, Shaanxi, Fujian, and Huguang great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 17, summer: a great drought struck the two capitals, Shandong, Shaanxi, Fujian, and Huguang.

sentences.zh: 十九年，畿內旱。

translations.literal: Year 19: drought within the metropolitan region.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 19: drought inside the capital region.

sentences.zh: 二十年三月，久旱，親禱。

translations.literal: Year 20, third month: prolonged drought; the emperor prayed in person.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 20, third month: after prolonged drought the emperor prayed in person.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，湖廣、江西旱。

translations.literal: Year 23: Huguang and Jiangxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 23: Huguang and Jiangxi had drought.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，南、北畿、山東、山西、陝西、浙江、江西、湖廣、河南俱旱。

translations.literal: Year 24: the southern and northern metropolitan regions, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, and Henan all drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 24: drought extended across both metropolitan regions, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Huguang, and Henan.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，南畿、江西旱。

translations.literal: Year 25: the Southern Metropolitan Region and Jiangxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 25: the Southern Metropolitan Region and Jiangxi suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，北畿、山西、陝西旱。

translations.literal: Year 29: the Northern Metropolitan Region, Shanxi, and Shaanxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 29: drought in the Northern Metropolitan Region, Shanxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，兗州、東昌、淮安、揚州、徐州、武昌旱。

translations.literal: Year 33: Yanzhou, Dongchang, Huai'an, Yangzhou, Xuzhou, and Wuchang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 33: drought at Yanzhou, Dongchang, Huai'an, Yangzhou, Xuzhou, and Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，陝西五府及太原旱。

translations.literal: Year 34: five Shaanxi prefectures and Taiyuan drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 34: five prefectures in Shaanxi and Taiyuan had drought.

sentences.zh: 三十五年夏，山東旱。

translations.literal: Year 35, summer: Shandong drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 35, summer: Shandong suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，大旱，禾盡槁。

translations.literal: Year 37: great drought; grain stalks withered entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 37: a great drought left every stalk of grain withered.

sentences.zh: 三十九年，太原、延安、慶陽、西安旱。

translations.literal: Year 39: Taiyuan, Yan'an, Qingyang, and Xi'an drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 39: drought at Taiyuan, Yan'an, Qingyang, and Xi'an.

sentences.zh: 四十年，保定等六府旱。

translations.literal: Year 40: six prefectures including Baoding drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 40: six prefectures including Baoding had drought.

sentences.zh: 四十一年，西安等六府旱。

translations.literal: Year 41: six prefectures including Xi'an drought.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 41: six prefectures including Xi'an suffered drought.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年，浙江、福建、四川、陝西及淮安、鳳陽大旱。

translations.literal: Longqing year 2: Zhejiang, Fujian, Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Huai'an and Fengyang great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2: a great drought afflicted Zhejiang, Fujian, Sichuan, Shaanxi, Huai'an, and Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 四年夏，旱，詔諸司停刑。

translations.literal: Year 4, summer: drought; an edict ordered all offices to suspend punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 4, summer: drought prompted an edict ordering all agencies to suspend executions.

sentences.zh: 六年夏，不雨。

translations.literal: Year 6, summer: no rain.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 6, summer: rain failed.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十一年八月庚戌朔，河東鹽臣言，解池旱涸，鹽花不生。

translations.literal: Wanli year 11, eighth month, new moon of day gengxu: the Hedong salt commissioner reported that the Jie Pond had dried in drought and salt flowers did not form.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 11, eighth month, new moon of day gengxu: the Hedong salt commissioner reported that drought had dried the Jie Pond so that no salt crystals formed.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月戊午，因久旱，步禱郊壇。

translations.literal: Year 13, fourth month, day wuwu: because of prolonged drought, paced prayer at the suburban altar.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 13, fourth month, day wuwu: after prolonged drought the court performed paced prayers at the suburban altar.

sentences.zh: 京師自去秋至此不雨，河井並涸。

translations.literal: The capital from last autumn until now had no rain; rivers and wells alike dried up.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 13: from the previous autumn through this date the capital had no rain and rivers and wells alike ran dry.

sentences.zh: 十四年三月乙巳，以久旱，命順天府祈禱。

translations.literal: Year 14, third month, day yisi: because of prolonged drought, Shuntian Prefecture was ordered to pray.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 14, third month, day yisi: prolonged drought led to an order for Shuntian Prefecture to conduct prayers.

sentences.zh: 十七年，蘇、鬆連歲大旱，震澤爲平陸。

translations.literal: Year 17: Suzhou and Songjiang had great drought for successive years; Lake Zhen became dry land.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 17: Suzhou and Songjiang suffered great drought year after year until Lake Tai lay as open plain.

sentences.zh: 浙江、湖廣、江西大旱。

translations.literal: Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 17: Zhejiang, Huguang, and Jiangxi also endured a great drought.

sentences.zh: 十八年四月，旱。

translations.literal: Year 18, fourth month: drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 18, fourth month: drought.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，杭、嘉、湖三府旱。

translations.literal: Year 24: the three prefectures Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 24: drought struck the prefectures of Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十六年四月，旱。

translations.literal: Year 26, fourth month: drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 26, fourth month: drought.

sentences.zh: 二十七年夏，旱。

translations.literal: Year 27, summer: drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 27, summer: drought.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，畿輔、山東、山西、河南及貴州黔東諸府衛旱。

translations.literal: Year 29: the metropolitan region, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, and the various prefectures and guards of eastern Guizhou drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 29: drought afflicted the capital region, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan, and the prefectures and guards of eastern Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 三十年夏，旱。

translations.literal: Year 30, summer: drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 30, summer: drought.

sentences.zh: 三十四年夏，亢旱。

translations.literal: Year 34, summer: severe drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 34, summer: severe drought.

sentences.zh: 三十七年，楚、蜀、河南、山東、山西、陝西皆旱。

translations.literal: Year 37: Chu, Sichuan, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi all drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 37: drought struck Chu, Sichuan, Henan, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 三十八年夏，久旱。

translations.literal: Year 38, summer: prolonged drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 38, summer: prolonged drought.

sentences.zh: 濟、青、登、萊四府大旱。

translations.literal: The four prefectures Jinan, Qingzhou, Dengzhou, and Laizhou great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 38: a great drought gripped the prefectures of Jinan, Qingzhou, Dengzhou, and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 三十九年夏，京師大旱。

translations.literal: Year 39, summer: the capital great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 39, summer: the capital suffered a great drought.

sentences.zh: 四十二年夏，不雨。

translations.literal: Year 42, summer: no rain.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 42, summer: no rain fell.

sentences.zh: 四十三年三月，不雨，至於六月。

translations.literal: Year 43, third month: no rain until the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 43: from the third month through the sixth month there was no rain.

sentences.zh: 山東春夏大旱，千里如焚。

translations.literal: Shandong spring and summer great drought; for a thousand li the land seemed afire.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 43: Shandong endured a spring-and-summer drought so severe that for a thousand li the countryside looked scorched.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，陝西旱。

translations.literal: Year 44: Shaanxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 44: Shaanxi had drought.

sentences.zh: 秋冬，廣東大旱。

translations.literal: Autumn and winter: Guangdong great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 44, autumn and winter: Guangdong suffered a great drought.

sentences.zh: 四十五年夏，畿南亢旱。

translations.literal: Year 45, summer: the south of the metropolitan region severe drought.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 45, summer: severe drought in the southern capital districts.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，廣西梧州旱，赤地如焚。

translations.literal: Year 47: Wuzhou in Guangxi drought; red ground as though burning.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 47: drought at Wuzhou in Guangxi left the earth red as if burned.

sentences.zh: 泰昌元年，遼東旱。

translations.literal: Taichang year 1: Liaodong drought.
translations.idiomatic: Taichang 1: Liaodong had drought.

sentences.zh: 天啓元年，久旱。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 1: prolonged drought.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 1: prolonged drought.

sentences.zh: 五年，真、順、保、河四府，三伏不雨，秋復旱。

translations.literal: Year 5: the four prefectures Zhending, Shuntian, Baoding, and Hejian had no rain through the three fu periods; autumn drought again.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 5: Zhending, Shuntian, Baoding, and Hejian went without rain through all three fu periods, and drought returned in autumn.

sentences.zh: 七年，四川大旱。

translations.literal: Year 7: Sichuan great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 7: Sichuan suffered a great drought.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年夏，畿輔旱，赤地千里。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 1, summer: the metropolitan region drought; red ground for a thousand li.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 1, summer: drought in the capital region left a thousand li of scorched earth.

sentences.zh: 三年三月，旱，擇日親禱。

translations.literal: Year 3, third month: drought; a day was chosen for the emperor to pray in person.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 3, third month: after drought the emperor chose a day to pray in person.

sentences.zh: 五年，杭、嘉、湖三府自八月至十月七旬不雨。

translations.literal: Year 5: the three prefectures Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou from the eighth month to the tenth month seventy days without rain.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 5: Hangzhou, Jiaxing, and Huzhou went seventy days without rain from the eighth through the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 六年，京師及江西旱。

translations.literal: Year 6: the capital and Jiangxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 6: drought afflicted the capital and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 十年夏，京師及河東不雨，江西大旱。

translations.literal: Year 10, summer: the capital and Hedong had no rain; Jiangxi great drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 10, summer: the capital and Hedong went without rain while Jiangxi endured a great drought.

sentences.zh: 十一年，兩京及山東、山西、陝西旱。

translations.literal: Year 11: the two capitals and Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 11: drought struck both capitals, Shandong, Shanxi, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十二年，畿南、山東、河南、山西、浙江旱。

translations.literal: Year 12: the south of the metropolitan region, Shandong, Henan, Shanxi, and Zhejiang drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 12: drought spread across the southern capital districts, Shandong, Henan, Shanxi, and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 十三年，兩京及登、青、萊三府旱。

translations.literal: Year 13: the two capitals and the three prefectures Dengzhou, Qingzhou, and Laizhou drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13: drought afflicted both capitals and the prefectures of Dengzhou, Qingzhou, and Laizhou.

sentences.zh: 十四年，兩京、山東、河南、湖廣及宣、大邊地旱。

translations.literal: Year 14: the two capitals, Shandong, Henan, Huguang, and the Xuanfu–Datong borderlands drought.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14: drought gripped both capitals, Shandong, Henan, Huguang, and the Xuanfu–Datong frontier.

sentences.zh: 十六年五月辛丑，祈禱雨澤，命臣工痛加修省。

translations.literal: Year 16, fifth month, day xinchou: prayers for rain; officials were ordered to reform themselves severely.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 16, fifth month, day xinchou: the court prayed for rain and ordered the ministers to undertake severe self-reform.

sentences.zh: ▲詩妖

translations.literal: ▲ Poetic anomalies.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Poetic Anomalies

sentences.zh: 正統二年，京師旱，街巷小兒爲土龍禱雨，拜而歌曰：「雨帝雨帝，城隍土地。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 2: the capital drought; alley children made clay dragons to pray for rain, bowing and singing: "Rain Emperor, Rain Emperor, City God and Earth Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 2: during a capital drought, street children fashioned clay dragons to pray for rain, bowing and chanting: "Rain Emperor, Rain Emperor, City God and Earth Lord.

sentences.zh: 雨若再來，還我土地。

translations.literal: If rain comes again, return our land."
translations.idiomatic: If rain comes again, give back our land."

sentences.zh: 」說者謂「雨帝。

translations.literal: Commentators said "Rain Emperor."
translations.idiomatic: Commentators said that "Rain Emperor"

sentences.zh: 」者，與弟也，帝弟同音。

translations.literal: meant "and younger brother"—Di and Di are homophones.
translations.idiomatic: meant "and younger brother"—the words for emperor (di) and younger brother (di) share the same sound.

sentences.zh: 「城隍。

translations.literal: "City God"
translations.idiomatic: "City God"

sentences.zh: 」者，郕王。

translations.literal: referred to the Prince of Ying.
translations.idiomatic: referred to the Prince of Ying.

sentences.zh: 「再來」、「還土地。

translations.literal: "Come again" and "return the land"
translations.idiomatic: "Come again" and "return the land"

sentences.zh: 」者，復辟也。

translations.literal: signified restoration to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: foretold restoration to the throne.

sentences.zh: ▲毛蟲之孽

translations.literal: ▲ Calamities among hairy insects.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Calamities among Hairy Insects

sentences.zh: 弘治九年八月，有黑熊自都城蓮池緣城上西直門，官軍逐之下，不能獲。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 9, eighth month: a black bear from the capital lotus pond climbed the city wall toward Xizhi Gate; government troops chased it down but could not capture it.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 9, eighth month: a black bear from the capital lotus pond climbed the city wall toward Xizhi Gate; troops pursued it down from the wall but could not seize it.

sentences.zh: 齧死一人，傷一人。

translations.literal: It bit one person to death and wounded another.
translations.idiomatic: It killed one person by biting and wounded another.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月，有熊自西直門入城，郎中何孟春曰：「當備盜，亦宜慎火。

translations.literal: Year 11, sixth month: a bear entered the city from Xizhi Gate; Langzhong He Mengchun said: "Guard against bandits, and also beware of fire."
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 11, sixth month: a bear entered the city through Xizhi Gate; the langzhong He Mengchun said, "Prepare against bandits and also guard against fire."

sentences.zh: 宋紹興間熊抵永嘉城，州守高世則以熊字能火，戒郡中慎火，果延燒廬舍，此其兆也。

translations.literal: In the Shaoxing period of Song a bear reached Yongjia city; the prefect Gao Shize took the character for bear as able to cause fire and warned the commandery to beware fire; dwellings indeed spread in flame—this was its omen.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoxing reign of Song a bear had reached Yongjia; the prefect Gao Shize read the word for bear as a sign of fire and warned the commandery to guard against blaze—and dwellings did indeed catch and spread; he took this as the precedent.

sentences.zh: 」是年，城內多火災。

translations.literal: That year there were many fires within the city.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 11: that year the capital saw many fires.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖五年七月，南城縣有虎，具人手足。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 5, seventh month: Nancheng County had a tiger with human hands and feet.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 5, seventh month: at Nancheng County a tiger appeared with human hands and feet.

sentences.zh: 四十五年六月，太醫院吏目李乾獻兔，體備五色，以爲瑞兔。

translations.literal: Year 45, sixth month: Imperial Medical Institute clerk Li Qian presented a rabbit whose body showed all five colors, taken as an auspicious rabbit.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 45, sixth month: Li Qian, a clerk of the Imperial Medical Institute, presented a rabbit marked in all five colors, which was hailed as an auspicious rabbit.

sentences.zh: ▲犬禍

translations.literal: ▲ Dog portents.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Dog Portents

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二十年，民家生一犬，八足四耳四目。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 20: a household produced a dog with eight legs, four ears, and four eyes.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 20: a common household whelped a dog with eight legs, four ears, and four eyes.

sentences.zh: 萬曆四十七年七月，懷寧民家產一犬，長五寸，高四寸，一頭二身八腳，狀如人。

translations.literal: Wanli year 47, seventh month: a Huaining household produced a dog five cun long and four cun high, one head and two bodies with eight feet, shaped like a human.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 47, seventh month: a household at Huaining whelped a dog five cun long and four cun high, with one head, two bodies, and eight feet in a humanlike form.

sentences.zh: ▲金異

translations.literal: ▲ Metal anomalies.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Metal Anomalies

sentences.zh: 洪武十一年正月元旦甲戌，早朝，殿上金鐘始叩，忽斷爲二。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 11, first month, New Year's day jiaxu: at early audience, as the hall's golden bell was first struck it suddenly broke in two.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 11, first month, New Year's day jiaxu: at the dawn audience, as the palace golden bell was first struck it suddenly snapped in two.

sentences.zh: 六月丁卯夜，寧夏衛風雨，兜鍪旗槊皆有火光。

translations.literal: Sixth month, night of day dingmao: at Ningxia Guard wind and rain; helmets, flags, and spears all showed fire-light.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 11, sixth month, night of day dingmao: wind and rain struck Ningxia Guard, and helmets, flags, and spears all glowed with fire.

sentences.zh: 十二年十二月甲子，徐州衛譙樓銅壺自鳴。

translations.literal: Year 12, twelfth month, day jiazi: at Xuzhou Guard the watchtower bronze clepsydra sounded of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 12, twelfth month, day jiazi: the bronze clepsydra in the watchtower at Xuzhou Guard rang of itself.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，復鳴。

translations.literal: Day yichou: it sounded again.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 12, day yichou: it rang again.

sentences.zh: 是歲，胡惟庸井中生石筍，去之，筍復旁出者三。

translations.literal: That year stone bamboo shoots grew in Hu Weiyong's well; when removed, shoots again emerged from the side three times.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 12: stone bamboo shoots sprouted in Hu Weiyong's well; removed, they thrust up again from the sides on three occasions.

sentences.zh: 次年，惟庸伏誅。

translations.literal: The next year Hu Weiyong was executed.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Hu Weiyong was put to death.

sentences.zh: 建文二年四月乙卯，燕王營於蘇家橋，兵端火光如球，上下相擊，金鐵錚錚，弓弦自鳴。

translations.literal: Jianwen year 2, fourth month, day yimao: the Prince of Yan encamped at Sujia Bridge; fire-light on weapons like balls, striking above and below; metal and iron clanging; bowstrings sounding of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwen 2, fourth month, day yimao: as the Prince of Yan camped at Sujia Bridge, weapon-tips flared like balls of fire clashing above and below, metal rang out, and bowstrings twanged of themselves.

sentences.zh: 成化十三年六月壬子，雨錢於京師。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 13, sixth month, day renzi: coins rained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 13, sixth month, day renzi: coins rained down in the capital.

sentences.zh: 正德四年三月甲寅，蓋州衛城樓鍾自鳴者三。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 4, third month, day jiayin: the Gaizhou Guard citadel bell sounded of itself three times.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 4, third month, day jiayin: the bell on the Gaizhou Guard citadel rang of itself three times.

sentences.zh: 七年，文登秦始皇廟鐘鼓自鳴。

translations.literal: Year 7: the bell and drum at the First Emperor temple at Wendeng sounded of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 7: the bell and drum at Wendeng's temple to the First Emperor rang of themselves.

sentences.zh: 成山衛如之。

translations.literal: Chengshan Guard likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 7: the same occurred at Chengshan Guard.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖六年五月甲午，京師雨錢。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 6, fifth month, day jiawu: coins rained in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 6, fifth month, day jiawu: coins rained in the capital.

sentences.zh: 隆慶六年七月七日，有物轟轟，飛至直隸華亭海濱墜於地，乃鍾也。

translations.literal: Longqing year 6, seventh day of the seventh month: something booming flew to the Zhili coast at Huating and fell to earth—it was a bell.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 6, seventh day of the seventh month: something boomed through the air to the Huating shore in Zhili and crashed to earth—it proved to be a bell.

sentences.zh: 鑄時年月具在，識者謂其來自閩云。

translations.literal: The year and month of casting were all inscribed; those who knew said it had come from Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Its casting date was fully inscribed; informed observers said it had come from Fujian.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十一年十月甲申，山東督撫令旗及刀槍頭皆火出，且有聲。

translations.literal: Wanli year 21, tenth month, day jiashen: the Shandong governor-general's signal flags and blade and spear heads all emitted fire, and there was sound as well.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 21, tenth month, day jiashen: the signal flags and spearheads of the Shandong governor-general burst into flame with a sound.

sentences.zh: 二十六年五月庚寅，古浪城樓大鐘自鳴者三。

translations.literal: Year 26, fifth month, day gengyin: the great bell on the Gulang citadel sounded of itself three times.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 26, fifth month, day gengyin: the great bell on the Gulang citadel rang of itself three times.

sentences.zh: 天啓六年五月丁未，京城石獅擲出城外。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 6, fifth month, day dingwei: stone lions in the capital were hurled outside the city wall.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 6, fifth month, day dingwei: stone lions in the capital were cast outside the city wall.

sentences.zh: 銀、錢、器皿飄至昌平閱武場中。

translations.literal: Silver, cash, and vessels drifted to the parade ground at Changping.
translations.idiomatic: Silver, cash, and vessels drifted to the review ground at Changping.

sentences.zh: 崇禎六年五月癸巳，有鐵斧飛落霍山縣。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 6, fifth month, day guisi: an iron axe flew down at Huoshan County.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 6, fifth month, day guisi: an iron axe fell from the sky at Huoshan County.

sentences.zh: 八年十二月辛巳，夜四鼓，山東鎮南城樓大砲鳴如鍾，至黎明，大吼一聲乃止。

translations.literal: Year 8, twelfth month, day xinsi: at the fourth watch of the night the great cannon on the Zhennan citadel in Shandong sounded like a bell until dawn, when one great roar ceased it.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 8, twelfth month, day xinsi: at the fourth watch the great cannon on Shandong's Zhennan citadel rang like a bell until dawn, when one thunderous blast ended it.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月丙申，蘄州城隍廟古鐘自鳴。

translations.literal: Year 13, third month, day bingchen: the ancient bell at the Qizhou City God temple sounded of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13, third month, day bingchen: the ancient bell at the Qizhou City God temple rang of itself.

sentences.zh: ▲白眚白祥

translations.literal: ▲ White afflictions and white omens.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ White Afflictions and White Omens

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年六月庚戌，中天有白氣，東西竟天。

translations.literal: Hongxi year 1, sixth month, day gengxu: mid-heaven had white vapor spanning east to west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxi 1, sixth month, day gengxu: a white vapor in mid-heaven stretched from east to west across the entire sky.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年六月癸未夜，有蒼白氣，東西竟天。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, sixth month, night of day guiwei: there was pale white vapor spanning east to west across the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, sixth month, night of day guiwei: pale white vapor ran east to west across the sky.

sentences.zh: 八月庚辰，東南有白氣，狀如羣羊驚走。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day gengchen: in the southeast white vapor shaped like a flock of sheep fleeing in alarm.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, eighth month, day gengchen: in the southeast white vapor took the shape of a flock of sheep stampeding.

sentences.zh: 既滅，有黑氣如死蛇，頃之分爲二。

translations.literal: After it vanished, black vapor like a dead serpent soon split in two.
translations.idiomatic: When it faded, black vapor like a dead serpent soon divided in two.

sentences.zh: 弘治五年十二月辛亥夜，東方有白氣，南北亙天，去地五丈。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 5, twelfth month, night of day xinhai: in the east white vapor ran north to south across the sky, five zhang above the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 5, twelfth month, night of day xinhai: in the east white vapor stretched north to south across the sky, five zhang above the earth.

sentences.zh: 正德元年三月戊申夜，太原空中見紅光，如彎弓，長六七尺。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, third month, night of day wushen: in the sky over Taiyuan red light appeared like a bent bow, six or seven chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, third month, night of day wushen: over Taiyuan a red glow like a bent bow, six or seven chi long, appeared in the sky.

sentences.zh: 旋變黃，又變白，漸長至二十餘丈，光芒亙天。

translations.literal: Soon it turned yellow, then white, gradually lengthening to more than twenty zhang; its radiance spanned the sky.
translations.idiomatic: It soon turned yellow, then white, stretching gradually to more than twenty zhang until its brilliance filled the heavens.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖七年十二月望，白氣亙天津。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 7, twelfth month, full moon: white vapor spanned Tianjin.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 7, on the full moon of the twelfth month: white vapor stretched across the Tianjin asterism.

sentences.zh: 《洪範》曰：「土爰稼穡。

translations.literal: The Hong Fan says: "Earth is called bringing forth grain and silk."
translations.idiomatic: The Hong Fan states: "Earth is defined as bringing forth grain and silk."

sentences.zh: 」稼穡不成，則土失其性矣。

translations.literal: When grain and silk do not succeed, earth loses its nature.
translations.idiomatic: When grain and silk fail to mature, Earth has forsaken its proper nature.

sentences.zh: 前史多以恆風、風霾、晦冥、花妖、蟲孽、牛禍、地震、山頹、雨毛、地生毛、年飢、黃眚黃祥皆屬之土，今從之。

translations.literal: Earlier histories mostly classified constant wind, wind haze, dimness, flower anomalies, insect calamities, cattle portents, earthquakes, mountain collapse, feather rain, ground growing hair, year famine, yellow afflictions and yellow omens all under earth; this follows them.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier dynastic histories grouped constant wind, wind haze, gloom, flower anomalies, insect calamities, cattle portents, earthquakes, mountain collapses, feather rain, hair growing from the ground, years of famine, and yellow afflictions and yellow auspices under the element Earth; this chapter follows that convention.

sentences.zh: ▲恆風

translations.literal: ▲ Constant wind.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Constant Wind

sentences.zh: 宣德六年六月，溫州颶風大作，壞公廨、祠廟、倉庫、城垣。

translations.literal: Xuande year 6, sixth month: a great hurricane at Wenzhou damaged government offices, temples, storehouses, and city walls.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 6, sixth month: a hurricane at Wenzhou wrecked government offices, temples, storehouses, and city walls.

sentences.zh: 正統四年七月，蘇、鬆、常、鎮四府大風，拔木殺稼。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 4, seventh month: the four prefectures Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang great wind; trees uprooted and crops killed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 4, seventh month: a great wind in Suzhou, Songjiang, Changzhou, and Zhenjiang uprooted trees and destroyed the crops.

sentences.zh: 天順二年二月，暴風拔孝陵松樹，懿文陵殿獸脊、樑柱多摧。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 2, second month: a violent wind uprooted Xiaoling pines; many roof-beast spines and beams and pillars of the Yiwen Mausoleum hall were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 2, second month: a violent wind uprooted the pines of Xiaoling and broke many ridge-beasts, beams, and pillars of the Yiwen Mausoleum hall.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，順天、河間、真定、保定、廣平、濟南連日烈風，麥苗盡敗。

translations.literal: Year 3, fourth month: Shuntian, Hejian, Zhending, Baoding, Guangping, and Jinan for successive days had fierce wind; wheat seedlings were entirely ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 3, fourth month: fierce winds day after day in Shuntian, Hejian, Zhending, Baoding, Guangping, and Jinan destroyed every wheat seedling.

sentences.zh: 成化十四年八月丁未，南京大風，拔太廟樹。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 14, eighth month, day dingwei: a great wind at Nanjing uprooted Imperial Ancestral Temple trees.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 14, eighth month, day dingwei: a great wind at Nanjing uprooted trees of the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 十五年八月辛卯，大風拔孝陵木。

translations.literal: Year 15, eighth month, day xinmao: a great wind uprooted Xiaoling trees.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 15, eighth month, day xinmao: a great wind uprooted trees at Xiaoling.

sentences.zh: 二十一年五月，南京大風拔太廟樹，摧大祀殿及皇城各門獸吻。

translations.literal: Year 21, fifth month: a great wind at Nanjing uprooted Imperial Ancestral Temple trees and destroyed the Great Sacrifice Hall and the beast ornaments on each gate of the Imperial City.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 21, fifth month: a great wind at Nanjing uprooted Imperial Ancestral Temple trees and wrecked the Great Sacrifice Hall and the ridge-beasts on every gate of the Imperial City.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年六月壬午朔，陝西靖虜衛大風，天地昏暗，變爲紅光如火，久之乃息。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 3, sixth month, new moon of day renwu: at Jinglao Guard in Shaanxi a great wind; heaven and earth grew dim, turning to red light like fire; only after a long while did it cease.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 3, sixth month, new moon of day renwu: a great wind at Jinglao Guard in Shaanxi darkened heaven and earth, which then flared red as fire before subsiding only after a long interval.

sentences.zh: 七年三月己亥，廣寧諸衛狂風，瀋陽、錦州城僕百餘丈。

translations.literal: Year 7, third month, day jihai: fierce wind in the various guards of Guangning; more than a hundred zhang of the ramparts of Shenyang and Jinzhou collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 7, third month, day jihai: fierce winds in the Guangning guards collapsed more than a hundred zhang of the ramparts at Shenyang and Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 正德元年六月辛酉，暴風折郊壇松柏，壞大祀殿、齋宮獸瓦。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, sixth month, day xinyou: a violent wind broke suburban altar pines and damaged beast tiles of the Great Sacrifice Hall and the Fasting Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, sixth month, day xinyou: a violent wind snapped pines at the suburban altar and broke ridge-beast tiles on the Great Sacrifice Hall and the Fasting Palace.

sentences.zh: 二年閏正月癸亥，盧龍、遷安大風拔樹毀屋。

translations.literal: Year 2, intercalary first month, day guihai: at Lulong and Qian'an a great wind uprooted trees and destroyed houses.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 2, intercalary first month, day guihai: a great wind at Lulong and Qian'an uprooted trees and wrecked houses.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，大風壞奉天門右吻。

translations.literal: Day yichou: a great wind damaged the right ridge-beast of Fengtian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 2, day yichou: a great wind broke the right ridge-beast of Fengtian Gate.

sentences.zh: 三年二月己丑，大同暴風，屋瓦飛動，三日而止。

translations.literal: Year 3, second month, day jichou: at Datong a violent wind; roof tiles flew; after three days it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 3, second month, day jichou: a violent wind at Datong sent roof tiles flying for three days before it ceased.

sentences.zh: 九年二月丁巳，長樂大雨雹，狂風震電，屋瓦皆飛。

translations.literal: Year 9, second month, day dingsi: at Changle great rain and hail; violent wind, thunder, and lightning; roof tiles all flew off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 9, second month, day dingsi: at Changle heavy rain and hail came with violent wind, thunder, and lightning, stripping every roof tile.

sentences.zh: 五月戊辰，曲阜暴風毀宣聖廟獸吻。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: at Qufu a violent wind destroyed the beast ornament of the Confucius temple.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 9, fifth month, day wuchen: a violent wind at Qufu broke the ridge-beast of the Confucius temple.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月丙辰，來賓大風雨雹，毀官民廬舍，屋瓦皆飛。

translations.literal: Year 12, fourth month, day bingchen: at Laibin great wind, rain, and hail destroyed official and private dwellings; roof tiles all flew off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 12, fourth month, day bingchen: at Laibin wind, rain, and hail wrecked official and private buildings and stripped the roof tiles.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸巳，南京大風雪，僕孝陵殿前樹及圍牆內外松柏。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day guisi: at Nanjing great wind and snow; trees before the Xiaoling hall and pine and cypress inside and outside the enclosing wall all fell.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 12, eleventh month, guisi: great wind and snow at Nanjing toppled the trees before the Xiaoling hall and the pine and cypress inside and outside the enclosing wall.

sentences.zh: 十二月己酉，大理衛大風，壞城樓。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiyou: at Dali Guard great wind damaged the gate tower.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, jiyou: great wind at Dali Guard damaged the gate tower.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月甲寅，慶符大風雹，壞學宮。

translations.literal: Year 13, third month, day jiayin: at Qingfu great wind and hail damaged the school temple.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 13, third month, jiayin: great wind and hail at Qingfu damaged the school temple.

sentences.zh: 十六年十二月辛卯，甘肅行都司狂風，壞官民廬舍樹木無算。

translations.literal: Year 16, twelfth month, day xinmao: at Gansu Branch Pacification Commission fierce wind damaged countless official and civilian dwellings and trees.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 16, twelfth month, xinmao: fierce wind at the Gansu Branch Pacification Commission destroyed countless official and civilian dwellings and trees.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年七月己巳，南京暴風雨，郊社、陵寢、宮闕、城垣獸吻、脊欄皆壞，拔樹萬餘株。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 1, seventh month, day jisi: at Nanjing violent wind and rain; suburban altars, mausoleums, palace halls, city walls, ridge beasts, and ridge rails were all damaged; more than ten thousand trees were uprooted.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 1, seventh month, jisi: violent wind and rain at Nanjing damaged the suburban altars, mausoleums, palace halls, city walls, ridge beasts, and ridge rails and uprooted more than ten thousand trees.

sentences.zh: 五年，陝西屢發大風，卷掣廟宇、民居百數十家，了無蹤跡。

translations.literal: Year 5: in Shaanxi great wind repeatedly arose, tearing away temples and civilian dwellings by the hundreds—leaving no trace.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 5: great wind repeatedly struck Shaanxi, tearing away temples and civilian dwellings by the hundreds and leaving no trace behind.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十八年三月甲辰，大名狂風，天色乍黑乍赤。

translations.literal: Wanli year 18, third month, day jiachen: at Daming fierce wind; the sky color alternated black and red.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 18, third month, jiachen: fierce wind at Daming; the sky turned now black, now red.

sentences.zh: 二十六年十月癸亥，喜峯路臺西北樓內，旋風大作，黑氣沖天，樓內有火光。

translations.literal: Year 26, tenth month, day guihai: within the northwest tower of Xifeng Route Platform, a whirlwind arose greatly; black qi rushed to heaven; inside the tower there was fire-light.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 26, tenth month, guihai: within the northwest tower of Xifeng Route Platform a great whirlwind arose, black qi shot skyward, and fire-light appeared inside the tower.

sentences.zh: 三十四年七月丙戌，大風拔朝日壇樹。

translations.literal: Year 34, seventh month, day bingxu: great wind uprooted the trees of the Morning Sun Altar.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 34, seventh month, bingxu: great wind uprooted the trees of the Morning Sun Altar.

sentences.zh: 四十一年八月乙未，青州大風拔樹，傾城屋。

translations.literal: Year 41, eighth month, day yiwei: at Qingzhou great wind uprooted trees and toppled city dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 41, eighth month, yiwei: great wind at Qingzhou uprooted trees and toppled city dwellings.

sentences.zh: 天啓元年三月辛亥，大風揚塵四塞。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 1, third month, day xinhai: great wind raised dust on all four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 1, third month, xinhai: great wind raised dust on all four sides.

sentences.zh: 四年五月癸亥，乾清宮東丹墀旋風驟作，內官監鐵片大如屋頂者，盤旋空中，隕於西墀，鏗訇若雷。

translations.literal: Year 4, fifth month, day guihai: at the east cinnabar terrace of the Qianqing Palace a whirlwind suddenly arose; iron sheets of the Directorate of Palace Manufactories as large as rooftops spiraled in the air and fell on the west terrace with a crash like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 4, fifth month, guihai: a whirlwind suddenly struck the east cinnabar terrace of the Qianqing Palace; iron sheets from the Directorate of Palace Manufactories, as large as rooftops, spiraled through the air and crashed onto the west terrace like thunder.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，薊州寒風殺人。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day wuxu: at Jizhou cold wind killed people.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, wuxu: cold wind at Jizhou killed people.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十四年五月，南陽大風拔屋。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 14, fifth month: at Nanyang great wind uprooted dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14, fifth month: great wind at Nanyang uprooted dwellings.

sentences.zh: 七月乙亥，福州大風，壞官署、民舍。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day yihai: at Fuzhou great wind damaged government offices and civilian dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, yihai: great wind at Fuzhou damaged government offices and civilian dwellings.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，保定廣平諸縣怪風，麥禾俱傷。

translations.literal: Year 15, fifth month: at Baoding, Guangping, and other counties strange wind; wheat and grain were all injured.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 15, fifth month: strange wind at Baoding, Guangping, and other counties; wheat and grain were all damaged.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月丁酉，大風，五鳳樓前門閂風斷三截，建極殿榱桷俱折。

translations.literal: Year 16, first month, day dingyou: great wind; before the Five Phoenix Tower the front gate bolt was broken in three pieces by wind; the rafters and eaves of the Jianji Hall were all broken.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 16, first month, dingyou: great wind broke the front gate bolt of the Five Phoenix Tower in three pieces and snapped all the rafters and eaves of the Jianji Hall.

sentences.zh: ▲風霾晦冥

translations.literal: ▲ Wind, haze, and darkness.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Wind, Haze, and Darkness

sentences.zh: 建文元年七月癸酉，燕王起兵，風雲四起，咫尺不辨人。

translations.literal: Jianwen year 1, seventh month, day guiyou: the Prince of Yan raised troops; wind and clouds arose on all four sides; at arm's length one could not distinguish people.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwen 1, seventh month, guiyou: when the Prince of Yan raised troops, wind and clouds rose on every side until people a few feet apart could not be told apart.

sentences.zh: 少焉東方露青天尺許，有光燭地，洞徹上下。

translations.literal: Shortly the east showed blue sky a foot or so; there was light illuminating the ground, penetrating above and below.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the east showed a strip of blue sky about a foot wide; a light shone upon the ground and pierced through above and below.

sentences.zh: 天順八年二月壬子，風霾晝晦。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 8, second month, day renzi: wind-haze; the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 8, second month, renzi: wind-haze darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 成化六年二月丁丑，開封晝晦如夜，黃霾蔽天。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 6, second month, day dingchou: at Kaifeng the day was dark as night; yellow haze covered the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 6, second month, dingchou: at Kaifeng the day was dark as night and yellow haze covered the sky.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，雨霾晝晦。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinsi: rain-haze; the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinsi: rain-haze darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 九年三月癸未，濟南諸府狂風晝晦，咫尺莫辨。

translations.literal: Year 9, third month, day guiwei: in the prefectures around Jinan fierce wind; the day was dark; at arm's length nothing could be distinguished.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 9, third month, guiwei: fierce wind darkened the day in the prefectures around Jinan until nothing could be distinguished an arm's length away.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月戊子，大名風霾，自辰迄申，紅黃滿空，俄黑如夜。

translations.literal: Year 21, third month, day wuzi: at Daming wind-haze from chen hour through shen hour; red and yellow filled the sky; soon it was black as night.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 21, third month, wuzi: at Daming wind-haze from the chen hour through the shen hour filled the sky with red and yellow, then suddenly turned black as night.

sentences.zh: 已而雨沙，數日乃止。

translations.literal: Then it rained sand; after several days it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Then it rained sand; after several days it ceased.

sentences.zh: 京師自正月至三月，風霾不雨。

translations.literal: At the capital from the first month through the third month, wind-haze without rain.
translations.idiomatic: At the capital from the first month through the third month there was wind-haze but no rain.

sentences.zh: 弘治二年二月辛亥，開封晝晦如夜。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 2, second month, day xinhai: at Kaifeng the day was dark as night.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 2, second month, xinhai: at Kaifeng the day was dark as night.

sentences.zh: 三月，黃塵四塞，風霾蔽天者累日。

translations.literal: Third month: yellow dust blocked on all four sides; wind-haze covered the sky for successive days.
translations.idiomatic: Third month: yellow dust blocked all four sides and wind-haze covered the sky for days on end.

sentences.zh: 四年八月乙卯，南京晦冥。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month, day yimao: at Nanjing darkness.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 4, eighth month, yimao: darkness at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 七年三月己亥，廣寧諸衛晝晦。

translations.literal: Year 7, third month, day jihai: at Guangning and other guards the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 7, third month, jihai: the day was dark at Guangning and the other guards.

sentences.zh: 正德五年三月甲子，大風霾，天色晦冥者數日。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 5, third month, day jiazi: great wind-haze; the sky color was dark for several days.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 5, third month, jiazi: great wind-haze kept the sky dark for several days.

sentences.zh: 十六年十一月辛酉，甘肅行都司黑風晝晦，翌日方散。

translations.literal: Year 16, eleventh month, day xinyou: at Gansu Branch Pacification Commission black wind; the day was dark; the next day it dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 16, eleventh month, xinyou: black wind at the Gansu Branch Pacification Commission darkened the day; it dispersed only the next day.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年九月己巳，大風霾，晝晦。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 1, ninth month, day jisi: great wind-haze; the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 1, ninth month, jisi: great wind-haze darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 八年正月戊戌朔，風霾，晦如夕。

translations.literal: Year 8, first month, new moon day wuxu: wind-haze; dark as evening.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 8, first month, new moon wuxu: wind-haze darkened the day like evening.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月乙丑，甘州五衛風霾晝晦，色赤復黃。

translations.literal: Year 26, seventh month, day yichou: at Ganzhou Five Guards wind-haze; the day was dark; the color red then yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 26, seventh month, yichou: wind-haze at the Ganzhou Five Guards darkened the day, turning red and then yellow.

sentences.zh: 二十八年三月丙申，風霾四塞，日色慘白，凡五日。

translations.literal: Year 28, third month, day bingshen: wind-haze blocked on all four sides; the sun's color was pallid white; in all five days.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 28, third month, bingshen: wind-haze blocked all four sides and the sun showed a pallid white color for five days.

sentences.zh: 三十年正月辛卯，大風揚塵蔽天，晝晦。

translations.literal: Year 30, first month, day xinmao: great wind raised dust covering the sky; the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 30, first month, xinmao: great wind raised dust that covered the sky and darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 四十年二月己酉，亦如之。

translations.literal: Year 40, second month, day jiyou: likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 40, second month, jiyou: the same occurred.

sentences.zh: 四月癸巳，大風雨，黃土晝晦。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guisi: great wind and rain; yellow earth; the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, guisi: great wind and rain with yellow earth darkened the day.

sentences.zh: 四十三年三月望，異風作，赤黃霾，至二十一日乃止。

translations.literal: Year 43, third month full moon: strange wind arose; red-yellow haze; until the twenty-first day it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 43, full moon of the third month: strange wind arose with red-yellow haze that did not cease until the twenty-first day.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年正月元旦，大風揚沙走石，白晝晦冥，自北畿抵江、浙皆同。

translations.literal: Longqing year 2, first month New Year's Day: great wind raised sand and drove stones; the white day was dark; from the Northern Metropolitan Region to Jiang and Zhe all were the same.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2, New Year's Day: great wind raised sand and drove stones until broad daylight turned dark from the Northern Metropolitan Region to Jiangsu and Zhejiang alike.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十七年正月乙丑，蓋州衛風霾晝晦，壞廨宇、廬舍。

translations.literal: Wanli year 17, first month, day yichou: at Gaizhou Guard wind-haze; the day was dark; damaged government offices and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 17, first month, yichou: wind-haze at Gaizhou Guard darkened the day and damaged government offices and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 二十五年二月戊寅，京師風霾。

translations.literal: Year 25, second month, day wuyin: at the capital wind-haze.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 25, second month, wuyin: wind-haze at the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十九年四月，連日風霾。

translations.literal: Year 29, fourth month: for successive days wind-haze.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 29, fourth month: wind-haze for days on end.

sentences.zh: 三十八年四月戊戌，崇陽風霾晝晦，至夜轉烈，損官民屋木無算。

translations.literal: Year 38, fourth month, day wuxu: at Chongyang wind-haze; the day was dark; by night it turned fierce; official and civilian dwellings and trees damaged beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 38, fourth month, wuxu: wind-haze at Chongyang darkened the day, turned fiercer by night, and damaged countless official and civilian dwellings and trees.

sentences.zh: 四十八年八月以前，雲南諸府時晝晦。

translations.literal: Year 48, before the eighth month: in the prefectures of Yunnan the day was at times dark.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 48, before the eighth month: in the prefectures of Yunnan the day was at times dark.

sentences.zh: 天啓元年四月乙亥午，寧夏洪廣堡風霾大作，墜灰片如瓜子，紛紛不絕，逾時而止。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 1, fourth month, day yihai at noon: at Ningxia Hongguang Fort wind-haze arose greatly; ash flakes like melon seeds fell in succession without cease; after a time it ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 1, fourth month, yihai at noon: great wind-haze at Ningxia Hongguang Fort; ash flakes like melon seeds fell in succession until, after a time, it ceased.

sentences.zh: 日將沈，作紅黃色，外如炊煙，圍罩畝許，日光所射如火焰，夜分乃沒。

translations.literal: The sun was about to set; it turned red-yellow; outside like cooking smoke, enclosing about a mu; where sunlight struck it was like flame; at midnight it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: As the sun was about to set it turned red-yellow; outside, smoke like from a cooking fire enclosed about a mu, and where sunlight struck it looked like flame; at midnight it vanished.

sentences.zh: 四年二月辛丑，風霾晝晦，塵沙蔽天，連日不止。

translations.literal: Year 4, second month, day xinchou: wind-haze; the day was dark; dust and sand covered the sky; for successive days without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 4, second month, xinchou: wind-haze darkened the day as dust and sand covered the sky for days without cease.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年正月癸亥，永年縣晝晦，咫尺不辨人物。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 1, first month, day guihai: at Yongnian County the day was dark; at arm's length one could not distinguish people and things.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 1, first month, guihai: at Yongnian County the day was so dark that people and things an arm's length away could not be distinguished.

sentences.zh: 七年三月戊子，黃州晝晦如夜。

translations.literal: Year 7, third month, day wuzi: at Huangzhou the day was dark as night.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 7, third month, wuzi: at Huangzhou the day was dark as night.

sentences.zh: 十三年閏正月丙申，南京日色晦朦，風霾大作，細灰從空下，五步外不見一物。

translations.literal: Year 13, intercalary first month, day bingshen: at Nanjing the sun's color was dim and hazy; great wind-haze arose; fine ash fell from the sky; beyond five paces nothing could be seen.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13, intercalary first month, bingshen: at Nanjing the sun looked dim and hazy, great wind-haze arose, and fine ash fell from the sky until nothing could be seen beyond five paces.

sentences.zh: 後四年三月丙申，風霾晝晦。

translations.literal: Four years later, third month, day bingshen: wind-haze; the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: Four years later, third month, bingshen: wind-haze darkened the day.

sentences.zh: ▲花孽

translations.literal: ▲ Flower anomalies.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Flower Anomalies

sentences.zh: 弘治十六年九月，安陸桃李華。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 16, ninth month: at Anlu peach and plum blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 16, ninth month: at Anlu peach and plum blossomed.

sentences.zh: 正德元年九月，宛平棗林莊李花盛開。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, ninth month: at Wanping Zaolin Village plum flowers bloomed profusely.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, ninth month: at Wanping Zaolin Village plum flowers bloomed profusely.

sentences.zh: 其冬，永嘉花盡放。

translations.literal: That winter: at Yongjia all flowers fully bloomed.
translations.idiomatic: That winter at Yongjia all flowers bloomed at once.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，霸州桃李華。

translations.literal: Year 6, eighth month: at Bazhou peach and plum blossomed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 6, eighth month: at Bazhou peach and plum blossomed.

sentences.zh: ▲蟲孽

translations.literal: ▲ Insect calamities.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Insect Calamities

sentences.zh: 景泰五年三月，畿南五府有蟲食桑，春蠶不育。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 5, third month: in the five prefectures south of the Metropolitan Region insects ate mulberry; spring silkworms did not thrive.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 5, third month: in the five prefectures south of the Metropolitan Region insects ate the mulberry and spring silkworms failed to thrive.

sentences.zh: 弘治六年八月己巳，臨晉雨蟲如雪。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 6, eighth month, day jisi: at Linjin insects rained like snow.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 6, eighth month, jisi: at Linjin insects rained down like snow.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，廣寧諸衛有黑蟲墮地，大如蠅，久之入於土。

translations.literal: Year 7, third month: at Guangning and other guards black insects fell to the ground, large as flies; after a long while they entered the earth.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 7, third month: at Guangning and the other guards black insects as large as flies fell to the ground and, after a long while, burrowed into the earth.

sentences.zh: ▲牛禍

translations.literal: ▲ Ox portents.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Ox Portents

sentences.zh: 正德十二年，徐州牛產犢，一頭二舌，兩尾八足。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 12: at Xuzhou an ox bore a calf with one head, two tongues, two tails, and eight feet.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 12: at Xuzhou an ox bore a calf with one head, two tongues, two tails, and eight feet.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖五年七月，南陽牛產犢，一首兩身。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 5, seventh month: at Nanyang an ox bore a calf with one head and two bodies.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 5, seventh month: at Nanyang an ox bore a calf with one head and two bodies.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，漳浦有牛產犢，三目三角。

translations.literal: Year 6, eleventh month: at Zhangpu an ox bore a calf with three eyes and three horns.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 6, eleventh month: at Zhangpu an ox bore a calf with three eyes and three horns.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月，銅仁黃牸產犢，滿身有紋，即死。

translations.literal: Year 11, second month: at Tongren a yellow cow bore a calf covered all over with markings; it died at once.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 11, second month: at Tongren a yellow cow bore a calf covered all over with markings; it died at once.

sentences.zh: 十二年，山東平山衛牛犢有紋，前兩足及尾悉具鱗甲，中皆毳毛。

translations.literal: Year 12: at Shandong Pingshan Guard an ox calf had markings; the fore two feet and tail all had scale armor; within were downy hairs.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 12: an ox calf at Pingshan Guard in Shandong bore markings; its forefeet and tail were covered in scales with downy hair between them.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十三年九月，光山牛產一物，火光滿地，鱗甲森然，一夕斃。

translations.literal: Wanli year 13, ninth month: at Guangshan an ox produced a thing; fire-light filled the ground; scale armor dense; in one night it died.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 13, ninth month: at Guangshan an ox produced a creature that filled the ground with fire-light, bore dense scales, and died within a night.

sentences.zh: 三十七年五月，歷城、高苑二縣牛各產犢，雙頭三眼，兩鼻二口。

translations.literal: Year 37, fifth month: at Licheng and Gaoyuan the two counties each had an ox bear a calf with two heads, three eyes, two noses, and two mouths.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 37, fifth month: at Licheng and Gaoyuan each county had an ox bear a calf with two heads, three eyes, two noses, and two mouths.

sentences.zh: 三十八年三月，獲嘉牛產犢，一身兩頭，四眼四耳，兩口兩足，一尾。

translations.literal: Year 38, third month: at Huojia an ox bore a calf with one body, two heads, four eyes, four ears, two mouths, two feet, and one tail.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 38, third month: at Huojia an ox bore a calf with one body, two heads, four eyes, four ears, two mouths, two feet, and one tail.

sentences.zh: 三十九年二月，汲縣牛產犢，一膊兩頭，兩口四眼，兩耳七蹄。

translations.literal: Year 39, second month: at Jixian an ox bore a calf with one shoulder and two heads, two mouths, four eyes, two ears, and seven hooves.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 39, second month: at Jixian an ox bore a calf with one shoulder and two heads, two mouths, four eyes, two ears, and seven hooves.

sentences.zh: 四月降夷部牛產犢，人頭羊耳。

translations.literal: Fourth month: at the Submissive Yi Department an ox bore a calf with a human head and sheep ears.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month: at the Submissive Yi Department an ox bore a calf with a human head and sheep ears.

sentences.zh: 四十五年八月，開州牛產犢，兩口三眼。

translations.literal: Year 45, eighth month: at Kaizhou an ox bore a calf with two mouths and three eyes.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 45, eighth month: at Kaizhou an ox bore a calf with two mouths and three eyes.

sentences.zh: 天啓元年十月，會寧牛產異獸，遍體鱗甲，有火光。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 1, tenth month: at Huining an ox bore a strange beast; all over the body scale armor; there was fire-light.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 1, tenth month: at Huining an ox bore a strange beast covered in scales that gave off fire-light.

sentences.zh: 三年十月，沅陵牸生犢，一身兩頭三尾。

translations.literal: Year 3, tenth month: at Yuanling a cow bore a calf with one body, two heads, and three tails.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 3, tenth month: at Yuanling a cow bore a calf with one body, two heads, and three tails.

sentences.zh: 七年三月，莒州牛產犢如麟。

translations.literal: Year 7, third month: at Juzhou an ox bore a calf like a qilin.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 7, third month: at Juzhou an ox bore a calf like a qilin.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十三年，襄陽牛產犢，兩頭二日。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 13: at Xiangyang an ox bore a calf with two heads and two suns.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13: at Xiangyang an ox bore a calf with two heads and two suns.

sentences.zh: ▲地震

translations.literal: ▲ Earthquakes.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Earthquakes

sentences.zh: 洪武四年正月己丑。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 4, first month, day jichou.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 4, first month, jichou.

sentences.zh: 鞏昌、臨洮、慶陽地震。

translations.literal: Gongchang, Lintao, and Qingyang earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Gongchang, Lintao, and Qingyang were shaken by earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五年四月戊戌，梧州府蒼梧、賀州、恭城、立山等處地震。

translations.literal: Year 5, fourth month, day wuxu: at Wuzhou Prefecture Cangwu, Hezhou, Gongcheng, Lishan, and other places earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 5, fourth month, wuxu: earthquake at Cangwu, Hezhou, Gongcheng, Lishan, and other places in Wuzhou Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯，太原府陽曲縣地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day guimao: at Taiyuan Prefecture Yangqu County earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, guimao: earthquake at Yangqu County in Taiyuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 七月辛亥，又震。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinhai: again shook.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, xinhai: it shook again.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，京師風雨地辰。

translations.literal: Day renxu: at the capital wind, rain, and earth-quake.
translations.idiomatic: Renxu: at the capital came wind, rain, and earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，太原府徐溝縣西北中有聲如雷，地震凡三日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guiwei: at Taiyuan Prefecture northwest of Xugou County there was sound like thunder; earthquake in all three days.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth month, guiwei: northwest of Xugou County in Taiyuan Prefecture a sound like thunder was heard and the earth shook for three days.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，陽曲縣地又震。

translations.literal: Day wuxu: at Yangqu County the ground again shook.
translations.idiomatic: Wuxu: Yangqu County shook again.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，又震者再。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renxu: again shook twice.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, renxu: it shook twice more.

sentences.zh: 十月戊寅、辛卯，復震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wuyin and day xinmao: again shook.
translations.idiomatic: Tenth month, wuyin and xinmao: it shook again.

sentences.zh: 是年，陽曲地凡七震。

translations.literal: That year: at Yangqu the ground in all seven shakes.
translations.idiomatic: That year Yangqu was shaken seven times in all.

sentences.zh: 自六年至十四年，復八震。

translations.literal: From year 6 through year 14, again eight shakes.
translations.idiomatic: From Hongwu 6 through Hongwu 14 it shook eight more times.

sentences.zh: 八年七月戊辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 8, seventh month, day wuchen: at the capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 8, seventh month, wuchen: earthquake at the capital.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，又震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuzi: again shook.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, wuzi: it shook again.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月乙巳，寧夏地震，壞城垣。

translations.literal: Year 11, fourth month, day yisi: at Ningxia earthquake; city walls damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 11, fourth month, yisi: earthquake at Ningxia damaged the city walls.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月甲戌，福州府、廣州府、河州地震。

translations.literal: Year 13, second month, day jiaxu: Fuzhou Prefecture, Guangzhou Prefecture, and Hezhou earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 13, second month, jiaxu: earthquake at Fuzhou Prefecture, Guangzhou Prefecture, and Hezhou.

sentences.zh: 十九年六月辛丑，雲南地震。

translations.literal: Year 19, sixth month, day xinchou: Yunnan earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 19, sixth month, xinchou: earthquake in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 十一月己卯，復震，有聲。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day jimao: again shook; there was sound.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, jimao: it shook again with a rumbling sound.

sentences.zh: 二十三年正月庚辰，山東地震。

translations.literal: Year 23, first month, day gengchen: Shandong earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 23, first month, gengchen: earthquake in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 建文元年三月甲午，京師地震，求直言。

translations.literal: Jianwen year 1, third month, day jiawu: at the capital earthquake; seek forthright speech.
translations.idiomatic: Jianwen 1, third month, jiawu: earthquake at the capital; the court called for forthright remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 永樂元年十一月甲午，北京地震。

translations.literal: Yongle year 1, eleventh month, day jiawu: Beijing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 1, eleventh month, day jiawu: Beijing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 山西、寧夏亦震。

translations.literal: Shanxi and Ningxia also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: Shanxi and Ningxia were shaken as well.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月癸丑，京師、濟南、開封並震，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 2, eleventh month, day guichou: the capital, Jinan, and Kaifeng all quaked together, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Yongle 2, eleventh month, day guichou: the capital, Jinan, and Kaifeng all shook together, with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 六年五月壬戌、十一年八月甲子，京師復震。

translations.literal: Year 6, fifth month, day renxu; year 11, eighth month, day jiazi: the capital again quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 6, on renxu, and in the eighth month of year 11, on jiazi, the capital shook again.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月壬戌、十四年九月癸卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 13, ninth month, day renxu; year 14, ninth month, day guimao: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 13, on renxu, and in the ninth month of year 14, on guimao, the capital was shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月丙午，北京地震。

translations.literal: Year 18, sixth month, day bingwu: Beijing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 18, on bingwu, Beijing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二十二年六月壬申，南京地震。

translations.literal: Year 22, sixth month, day renshen: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 22, on renshen, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年七月癸巳，京師地震，有聲，自東南迄西北。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, seventh month, day guisi: the capital was shaken by earthquake, with sound from the southeast reaching to the northwest.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, seventh month, day guisi: the capital was shaken by an earthquake, with rumbling heard from the southeast to the northwest.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南京地震者九。

translations.literal: That year, Nanjing was shaken by earthquake nine times.
translations.idiomatic: That year Nanjing was struck by nine earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 二年春，復震者十。
