translations.literal: Year 2, spring: it quaked again ten times.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of year 2 it shook again ten times.

sentences.zh: 三年，復屢震。

translations.literal: Year 3, again it quaked repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 it shook repeatedly once more.

sentences.zh: 四年，兩京地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, both capitals were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 both capitals were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 五年正月壬子，南京地震。

translations.literal: Year 5, first month, day renzi: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 5, on renzi, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，又震。

translations.literal: Day xinyou: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou it shook again.

sentences.zh: 正統三年三月己亥，京師地震。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 3, third month, day jihai: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 3, third month, day jihai: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 庚子，又震。

translations.literal: Day gengzi: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi it shook again.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，又震者再。

translations.literal: Day jiachen: again it quaked twice.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen it shook twice more.

sentences.zh: 四年六月乙未，復震。

translations.literal: Year 4, sixth month, day yiwei: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 4, on yiwei, it shook again.

sentences.zh: 八月己亥，又震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jihai: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jihai, it shook again.

sentences.zh: 五年十月庚午朔，蘭州、莊浪地震十日。

translations.literal: Year 5, tenth month, new moon on day gengwu: Lanzhou and Zhuanglang were shaken by earthquake for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 5, on the gengwu new moon, Lanzhou and Zhuanglang trembled for ten days.

sentences.zh: 十月、十一月屢震，壞城堡廬舍，壓死人畜。

translations.literal: In the tenth and eleventh months it quaked repeatedly, ruining fortresses, castles, and dwellings and crushing people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: Through the tenth and eleventh months it shook repeatedly, destroying fortresses, castles, and houses and crushing people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 十年二月丁巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 10, second month, day dingsi: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 10, on dingsi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 景泰二年七月癸丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: Jingtai year 2, seventh month, day guichou: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtai 2, seventh month, day guichou: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，永新珠坑村地陷十七所。

translations.literal: Year 3, seventh month: at Zhukeng Village in Yongxin, the ground sank in seventeen places.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 3, the ground sank in seventeen places at Zhukeng Village in Yongxin.

sentences.zh: 是年，南京地震。

translations.literal: That year, Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That year Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五年十月庚子，京師地震，有聲，起西北迄東南。

translations.literal: Year 5, tenth month, day gengzi: the capital was shaken by earthquake, with sound rising in the northwest and reaching to the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 5, on gengzi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake, with rumbling from the northwest to the southeast.

sentences.zh: 六年二月甲午，安福大雷雨。

translations.literal: Year 6, second month, day jiawu: at Anfu there was a great thunderstorm.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 6, on jiawu, Anfu was struck by a great thunderstorm.

sentences.zh: 白泉陂羊塘地陷二，一深三丈，廣十餘丈，一深六尺，廣一丈有奇。

translations.literal: At Baiquanpi and Yangtang the ground sank in two places — one three zhang deep and more than ten zhang across, one six chi deep and a little over one zhang across.
translations.idiomatic: At Baiquanpi and Yangtang the ground collapsed in two places: one three zhang deep and more than ten zhang wide, the other six chi deep and somewhat over one zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 天順元年十月乙巳，南京地震。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 1, tenth month, day yisi: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 1, tenth month, day yisi: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 成化元年四月甲申，鈞州地震，二十三日乃止。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 1, fourth month, day jiashen: Jun Prefecture was shaken by earthquake; only on the twenty-third day did it stop.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 1, fourth month, day jiashen: Jun Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake that did not cease until the twenty-third day.

sentences.zh: 三年，四川地震，凡三百七十五。

translations.literal: Year 3, Sichuan was shaken by earthquake — in all, three hundred seventy-five times.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 Sichuan was shaken by earthquakes three hundred seventy-five times in all.

sentences.zh: 五月壬申，宣府、大同地震，有聲，威遠、朔州亦震，壞墩臺牆垣，壓傷人。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renshen: Xuanfu and Datong were shaken by earthquake with sound; Weiyuan and Shuozhou also quaked, beacon towers and walls were ruined, and people were crushed and injured.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renshen, Xuanfu and Datong were shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling; Weiyuan and Shuozhou quaked as well, beacon towers and walls were wrecked, and people were crushed and injured.

sentences.zh: 四年八月癸巳，京師地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month, day guisi: the capital was shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 4, on guisi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊戌，湖廣地震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuxu: Huguang was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu, Huguang was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五年十二月丙辰，汝寧、武昌、漢陽、岳州同日地震。

translations.literal: Year 5, twelfth month, day bingchen: Runing, Wuchang, Hanyang, and Yue Prefecture were shaken by earthquake on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 5, on bingchen, Runing, Wuchang, Hanyang, and Yue Prefecture were shaken by earthquakes on the same day.

sentences.zh: 六年正月丁亥，河南地震。

translations.literal: First month, year 6, day dinghai: Henan was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 6, on dinghai, Henan was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是年，湖廣亦震。

translations.literal: That year, Huguang also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: That year Huguang quaked as well.

sentences.zh: 十年四月壬午，鶴慶地震。

translations.literal: Year 10, fourth month, day renwu: Heqing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 10, on renwu, Heqing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月己巳，自寅至申，復十五震，壞廨舍民居，傷人畜。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jisi: from the hour yin to the hour shen it again quaked fifteen times, ruining government offices and private dwellings and injuring people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi, from the yin hour to the shen hour it shook fifteen more times, destroying government offices and private houses and injuring people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 十月丁酉，靈州大沙井驛地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingyou: at Dashajing Post in Ling Prefecture there was an earthquake, with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingyou, Dashajing Post in Ling Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake that sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 自後晝夜屢震，至十一月甲寅，一日十一震，城堞房屋多圮。

translations.literal: Afterward it quaked repeatedly day and night; by the eleventh month, day jiayin, in one day there were eleven quakes, and many parapets, walls, and houses collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter it shook repeatedly day and night; by the eleventh month, on jiayin, there were eleven tremors in a single day, and many parapets, walls, and houses collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月辛亥，南京地震。

translations.literal: Year 12, first month, day xinhai: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 12, on xinhai, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月辛巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinsi: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinsi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月己巳，鳳陽、臨淮地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 13, first month, day jisi: Fengyang and Linhuai were shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 13, on jisi, Fengyang and Linhuai were shaken by earthquakes with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 閏二月癸卯，臨洮、鞏昌地震，城有頹者。

translations.literal: Intercalary second month, day guimao: Lintao and Gongchang were shaken by earthquake; in places the city walls collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month, on guimao, Lintao and Gongchang were shaken by earthquakes, and sections of the city walls gave way.

sentences.zh: 四月戊戌，甘肅地裂，又震，有聲。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day wuxu: in Gansu the ground split open, and again there was an earthquake with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on wuxu, the ground split open in Gansu, and an earthquake with audible rumbling followed.

sentences.zh: 榆林、涼州亦震。

translations.literal: Yulin and Liangzhou also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: Yulin and Liangzhou quaked as well.

sentences.zh: 寧夏大震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Ningxia had a great earthquake, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Ningxia suffered a great earthquake whose sound was like thunder.

sentences.zh: 城垣崩壞者八十三處。

translations.literal: Eighty-three places in the city walls collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Eighty-three sections of the city walls collapsed.

sentences.zh: 甘州、鞏昌、榆林、涼州及沂州、郯城、滕、費、嶧等縣，同日俱震。

translations.literal: Ganzhou, Gongchang, Yulin, Liangzhou, and the counties of Yizhou, Tancheng, Teng, Fei, and Yi all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Ganzhou, Gongchang, Yulin, Liangzhou, and the counties of Yizhou, Tancheng, Teng, Fei, and Yi all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 九月甲戌，京師地三震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiaxu: the capital ground quaked three times.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jiaxu, the capital trembled three times.

sentences.zh: 十四年六月，廣西太平府地震，至八月乙巳，凡七震。

translations.literal: Year 14, sixth month: Taiping Prefecture in Guangxi was shaken by earthquake; by the eighth month, day yisi, in all there were seven quakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 14 Taiping Prefecture in Guangxi was shaken by earthquakes; by the eighth month, on yisi, there had been seven tremors in all.

sentences.zh: 七月，四川鹽井衛地連震，廨宇傾覆，人畜多死。

translations.literal: Seventh month: at Yanjing Guard in Sichuan the ground quaked in succession; government buildings toppled, and many among people and livestock died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the ground at Yanjing Guard in Sichuan shook in succession; government buildings collapsed, and many people and livestock perished.

sentences.zh: 十六年八月丁巳，四川越巂衛一日七震，越數日連震。

translations.literal: Year 16, eighth month, day dingsi: at Yuexi Guard in Sichuan there were seven quakes in one day; over several days it quaked in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 16, on dingsi, Yuexi Guard in Sichuan suffered seven earthquakes in one day, followed over several days by continuous tremors.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月甲寅，南京、鳳陽、廬州、淮安、揚州、和州、兗州及河南州縣，同日地震。

translations.literal: Year 17, second month, day jiayin: Nanjing, Fengyang, Luzhou, Huai'an, Yangzhou, He Prefecture, Yanzhou, and the prefectures and counties of Henan all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 17, on jiayin, Nanjing, Fengyang, Luzhou, Huai'an, Yangzhou, He Prefecture, Yanzhou, and the prefectures and counties of Henan all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌，直隸薊州遵化縣地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuxu: Zunhua County in Zhili Jizhou was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuxu, Zunhua County in Zhili Jizhou was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，又震，日三次。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiachen: again it quaked — three times that day.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiachen, it shook again three times that day.

sentences.zh: 永平府及遼東寧遠衛亦三震。

translations.literal: Yongping Prefecture and Ningyuan Guard in Liaodong also quaked three times.
translations.idiomatic: Yongping Prefecture and Ningyuan Guard in Liaodong also shook three times.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月庚寅，京師及永平、宣府、遼東皆震。

translations.literal: Year 20, first month, day gengyin: the capital together with Yongping, Xuanfu, and Liaodong all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 20, on gengyin, the capital together with Yongping, Xuanfu, and Liaodong all shook.

sentences.zh: 宣府地裂，涌沙出水。

translations.literal: At Xuanfu the ground split open, and sand gushed forth with water.
translations.idiomatic: At Xuanfu the ground split open, and sand and water gushed forth.

sentences.zh: 天壽山、密雲、古北口、居庸關城垣墩堡多摧，人有壓死者。

translations.literal: At Tianshou Mountain, Miyun, Gubeikou, and Juyong Pass many city walls, parapets, and forts were destroyed, and some people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Tianshou Mountain, Miyun, Gubeikou, and Juyong Pass many city walls, parapets, and forts were destroyed, and some people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 五月甲寅，代州地七震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiayin: at Daizhou the ground quaked seven times.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiayin, the ground at Daizhou shook seven times.

sentences.zh: 九月辛巳，費縣地陷，深二尺，縱橫三丈許。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinsi: at Fei County the ground sank two chi deep, about three zhang long and wide.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinsi, the ground at Fei County sank two chi deep over an area of roughly three zhang.

sentences.zh: 二十一年二月壬申，泰安地震。

translations.literal: Year 21, second month, day renshen: Tai'an was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 21, on renshen, Tai'an was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午朔，復震，聲如雷，泰山動搖。

translations.literal: Third month, new moon on day renwu: again it quaked, the sound like thunder, and Mount Tai swayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on the renwu new moon, it shook again with a sound like thunder, and Mount Tai swayed.

sentences.zh: 後四日復微震，癸巳、乙未、庚子連震。

translations.literal: Four days later there was again a slight quake; on guisi, yiwei, and gengzi it quaked in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Four days later there was a slight tremor again; on guisi, yiwei, and gengzi it shook in succession.

sentences.zh: 閏四月癸未，鞏昌府、固原衛及蘭、河、洮、岷四州，地俱震，有聲。

translations.literal: Intercalary fourth month, day guimao: Gongchang Prefecture, Guyuan Guard, and the four prefectures Lan, He, Tao, and Min all quaked together, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fourth month, on guimao, Gongchang Prefecture, Guyuan Guard, and the four prefectures Lan, He, Tao, and Min all shook together with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，薊州遵化縣地震，有聲，越數日復連震，城垣民居有頹僕者。

translations.literal: Day guisi: Zunhua County in Jizhou was shaken by earthquake, with sound; after several days it again quaked in succession, and in places city walls and private dwellings collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Zunhua County in Jizhou was shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling; after several days tremors returned in succession, and sections of the city walls and private houses collapsed.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，京師地再震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day renxu: the capital ground quaked twice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on renxu, the capital trembled twice.

sentences.zh: 九月丙辰，廉州、梧州地震，有聲，連震者十六日。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingchen: Lian Prefecture and Wuzhou were shaken by earthquake, with sound; tremors continued for sixteen days.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingchen, Lian Prefecture and Wuzhou were shaken by earthquakes with audible rumbling that continued for sixteen days.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingyin: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingyin, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 二十二年六月壬辰，漢中府及寧羌衛地裂，或十餘丈，或六七丈。

translations.literal: Year 22, sixth month, day renchen: at Hanzhong Prefecture and Ningqiang Guard the ground split open — in places ten-odd zhang, in places six or seven zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 22, on renchen, the ground at Hanzhong Prefecture and Ningqiang Guard split open, in places more than ten zhang and in places six or seven zhang.

sentences.zh: 寶雞縣裂三里，闊丈餘。

translations.literal: Baoji County split open for three li, more than one zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: Baoji County split open for three li, more than one zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 九月辛亥，成都地日七八震，俱有聲。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day xinhai: at Chengdu the ground quaked seven or eight times in a day, all with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinhai, the ground at Chengdu shook seven or eight times in one day, each with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 次日，復震。

translations.literal: The next day, again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: The next day it shook again.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年八月壬寅，漢、茂二州地震，僕黃頭等寨碉房三十七戶，人口有壓死者。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 1, eighth month, day renyin: Han and Mao, the two prefectures, were shaken by earthquake; thirty-seven stockade watchtower dwellings at Huangtou and elsewhere collapsed, and among the population some were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 1, eighth month, day renyin: Han and Mao, the two prefectures, were shaken by an earthquake; thirty-seven stockade watchtower dwellings at Huangtou and elsewhere collapsed, and some of the inhabitants were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 戊申，宣府葛峪堡地陷深三尺，長百五十步，闊一丈。

translations.literal: Day wushen: at Geyu Fort in Xuanfu the ground sank three chi deep, one hundred fifty bu long, and one zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the ground at Geyu Fort in Xuanfu sank three chi deep, one hundred fifty bu long, and one zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 沙河中涌疄，高一尺，長七十步。

translations.literal: From the sand water gushed up in a mound one chi high and seventy bu long.
translations.idiomatic: Sand and water gushed up into a mound one chi high and seventy bu long.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛卯，四川地震，連三日。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day xinmao: Sichuan was shaken by earthquake for three days in succession.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinmao, Sichuan was shaken by earthquakes for three days in succession.

sentences.zh: 二年五月庚申，成都地震，連三日，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 2, fifth month, day gengshen: Chengdu was shaken by earthquake for three days in succession, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 2, on gengshen, Chengdu was shaken by earthquakes for three days in succession with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月己未，京師地再震。

translations.literal: Year 3, twelfth month, day jiwei: the capital ground quaked twice.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 3, on jiwei, the capital trembled twice.

sentences.zh: 四年六月辛亥，復三震。

translations.literal: Year 4, sixth month, day xinhai: again three quakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 4, on xinhai, it shook three more times.

sentences.zh: 八月乙卯，南京地震，屋宇皆搖。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yimao: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake; all the houses swayed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yimao, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake, and every house swayed.

sentences.zh: 淮、揚二府同日震。

translations.literal: Huai'an and Yangzhou prefectures quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Huai'an and Yangzhou prefectures shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，寧夏地震，連三年，共二十震。

translations.literal: Year 6, third month: Ningxia was shaken by earthquake; over three years in all there were twenty quakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 6 Ningxia was shaken by earthquakes; over three years there were twenty tremors in all.

sentences.zh: 四月甲辰，開封、衛輝、東昌、兗州同日地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day jiachen: Kaifeng, Weihui, Dongchang, and Yanzhou quaked on the same day, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiachen, Kaifeng, Weihui, Dongchang, and Yanzhou shook on the same day with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 七年二月丁丑，曲靖地震，壞房屋，壓死軍民。

translations.literal: Year 7, second month, day dingchou: Qujing was shaken by earthquake; houses were ruined and soldiers and civilians were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 7, on dingchou, Qujing was shaken by an earthquake that wrecked houses and crushed soldiers and civilians to death.

sentences.zh: 是歲，兩京並六震。

translations.literal: That year, both capitals each quaked six times.
translations.idiomatic: That year each of the two capitals shook six times.

sentences.zh: 八年三月己亥，寧夏地震十二次，聲如雷，傾倒邊牆、墩臺、房屋，壓傷人。

translations.literal: Year 8, third month, day jihai: Ningxia was shaken by earthquake twelve times, the sound like thunder, toppling frontier walls, beacon towers, and houses and crushing and injuring people.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 8, on jihai, Ningxia was shaken by twelve earthquakes whose sound was like thunder, toppling frontier walls, beacon towers, and houses and crushing and injuring people.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午至辛丑，安南衛地十二震。

translations.literal: From the ninth month, day jiawu, to xinmao: at Annan Guard the ground quaked twelve times.
translations.idiomatic: From jiawu to xinmao in the ninth month the ground at Annan Guard shook twelve times.

sentences.zh: 十月壬戌至甲子，海州九震。

translations.literal: From the tenth month, day renxu, to jiazi: at Haizhou there were nine quakes.
translations.idiomatic: From renxu to jiazi in the tenth month Haizhou suffered nine earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，南京地再震。

translations.literal: That year, the capital ground quaked twice.
translations.idiomatic: That year the capital trembled twice.

sentences.zh: 九年，兩京地震者各二次。

translations.literal: Year 9, both capitals were each shaken by earthquake twice.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 each of the two capitals was shaken twice by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十年正月戊午，京師、山西地震。

translations.literal: Year 10, first month, day wuwu: the capital and Shanxi were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 10, on wuwu, the capital and Shanxi were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，海豐地震，聲如雷，數日乃止。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day yihai: Haifeng was shaken by earthquake, the sound like thunder; only after several days did it stop.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yihai, Haifeng was shaken by an earthquake that sounded like thunder and did not cease until several days had passed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，真定、寧夏、榆林、鎮番、靈州、太原皆震。

translations.literal: That year, Zhending, Ningxia, Yulin, Zhenfan, Ling Prefecture, and Taiyuan all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: That year Zhending, Ningxia, Yulin, Zhenfan, Ling Prefecture, and Taiyuan all shook.

sentences.zh: 屯留尤甚，如舟將覆，屋瓦皆落。

translations.literal: At Tunliu it was especially severe — like a boat about to capsize; all the roof tiles fell.
translations.idiomatic: At Tunliu the shaking was especially severe, as though a boat were about to capsize, and every roof tile fell.

sentences.zh: 十一年六月丙子，桂林地有聲若雷，旋陷九處，大者圍十七丈，小者七丈或三丈。

translations.literal: Year 11, sixth month, day bingzi: at Guilin the ground made a sound like thunder; presently it sank in nine places — the large ones seventeen zhang around, the small ones seven zhang or three zhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 11, on bingzi, the ground at Guilin roared like thunder, then sank in nine places: the largest seventeen zhang across, the smaller seven or three zhang.

sentences.zh: 十三年七月己巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 13, seventh month, day jisi: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 13, on jisi, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申，兩京、鳳陽同時地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day wushen: both capitals and Fengyang quaked at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on wushen, both capitals and Fengyang shook at the same time.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月庚戌朔，延安、慶陽二府，同、華諸州，咸陽、長安諸縣，潼關諸衛，連日地震，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Year 14, first month, day gengxu, new moon: Yan'an and Qingyang, the two prefectures; Tong, Hua, and the other prefectures; Xianyang, Chang'an, and the other counties; Tong Pass and the other guards — for days on end the ground quaked, with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 14, new moon on gengxu: Yan'an and Qingyang prefectures, Tong and Hua and other prefectures, Xianyang and Chang'an and other counties, and Tong Pass and other guards were shaken day after day by earthquakes that sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 朝邑尤甚，頻震十七日，城垣、民舍多摧，壓死人畜甚衆。

translations.literal: At Chaoyi it was especially severe; it quaked repeatedly for seventeen days; city walls and civilian dwellings largely collapsed, and very many people and livestock were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Chaoyi the shaking was especially severe: tremors continued for seventeen days, city walls and private houses collapsed in large numbers, and a great many people and animals were killed.

sentences.zh: 縣東地拆，水溢成河。

translations.literal: East of the county the ground split open, and water overflowed to form a river.
translations.idiomatic: East of the county the earth split apart and water poured out to form a river.

sentences.zh: 自夏至冬，復七震。

translations.literal: From summer to winter it quaked seven more times.
translations.idiomatic: From summer through winter there were seven further earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是日，陝州，永寧、盧氏二縣，平陽府安邑、榮河二縣，俱震，有聲。

translations.literal: That day, Shaan Prefecture; Yongning and Lushi, the two counties; Anyi and Ronghe in Pingyang Prefecture — all quaked, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: On the same day Shaan Prefecture, Yongning and Lushi counties, and Anyi and Ronghe in Pingyang Prefecture all shook with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 蒲州自是日至戊午連震。

translations.literal: Pu Prefecture from that day to wuwu quaked continuously.
translations.idiomatic: Pu Prefecture shook without pause from that day through wuwu.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，福、興、泉、漳四府地俱震。

translations.literal: Day dingchou: the ground of Fu, Xing, Quan, and Zhang, the four prefectures, all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the ground shook throughout Fu, Xing, Quan, and Zhang prefectures.

sentences.zh: 二月乙未，蒲州地又震，至三月癸亥，凡二十九震。

translations.literal: Second month, day yimao: Pu Prefecture quaked again; up to third month, day guihai, in all there were twenty-nine quakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on yimao, Pu Prefecture shook again; by guihai in the third month there had been twenty-nine tremors in all.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，四川可渡河巡檢司地裂而陷，涌泉數十派，沖壞橋樑、莊舍，壓死人畜甚衆。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guichou: at the Keduo River inspection station in Sichuan the ground split open and sank; dozens of springs gushed forth, washing away bridges and farmsteads, and very many people and livestock were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, the ground at the Keduo River inspection post in Sichuan split and subsided; dozens of springs burst out, destroying bridges and homesteads and crushing a great many people and livestock.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，貴州地三震。

translations.literal: Day guiyou: Guizhou quaked three times.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Guizhou was shaken three times.

sentences.zh: 十月辛酉，南京地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day xinyou: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinyou, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十五年九月丙戌，南京、徐州、大名、順德、濟南、東昌、兗州同日地震，壞城垣、民舍。

translations.literal: Year 15, ninth month, day bingxu: Nanjing, Xuzhou, Daming, Shunde, Jinan, Dongchang, and Yanzhou all quaked on the same day, damaging city walls and dwellings.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 15, on bingxu, Nanjing, Xuzhou, Daming, Shunde, Jinan, Dongchang, and Yanzhou all shook on the same day, damaging walls and houses.

sentences.zh: 濮州尤甚，地裂涌水，壓死百餘人。

translations.literal: At Puzhou it was especially severe; the ground split and water gushed up, crushing more than one hundred people to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Puzhou the damage was especially severe: the ground cracked, water surged up, and more than a hundred people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 是日，開封、彰德、平陽、澤、潞亦震。

translations.literal: That day, Kaifeng, Zhangde, Pingyang, Ze, and Lu also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On the same day Kaifeng, Zhangde, Pingyang, Ze, and Lu shook as well.

sentences.zh: 十月甲子，山西應、朔、代三州，山陰、馬邑、陽曲等縣，地俱震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiazi: Ying, Shuo, and Dai, the three prefectures in Shanxi; Shanyin, Mayi, Yangqu, and the other counties — the ground all quaked, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiazi, Ying, Shuo, and Dai prefectures in Shanxi and Shanyin, Mayi, Yangqu, and other counties all trembled with thunderous rumbling.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，南京地震。

translations.literal: Day dingmao: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十六年二月庚申，南京地震。

translations.literal: Year 16, second month, day gengshen: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 16, on gengshen, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月癸亥，寧夏地震，聲如雷，城傾圮。

translations.literal: Year 18, sixth month, day guihai: Ningxia was shaken by earthquake, the sound like thunder; the city walls toppled and collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 18, on guihai, Ningxia was shaken by an earthquake that sounded like thunder; the city walls collapsed.

sentences.zh: 九月癸巳，杭、嘉、紹、寧四府地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day guisi: Hang, Jia, Shao, and Ning, the four prefectures, were shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on guisi, Hang, Jia, Shao, and Ning prefectures were shaken by earthquakes with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 甲午，南京及蘇、鬆、常、鎮、淮、揚、寧七府，通、和二州，同日地震。

translations.literal: Day jiawu: Nanjing and Su, Song, Chang, Zhen, Huai, Yang, and Ning, the seven prefectures, and Tong and He, the two prefectures, all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Nanjing and the seven prefectures of Su, Song, Chang, Zhen, Huai, Yang, and Ning, together with Tong and He prefectures, all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，蒲、解二州，絳、夏、平陸、榮河、聞喜、芮城、猗氏七縣地俱震，有聲。

translations.literal: Day xinchou: Pu and Jie, the two prefectures; Jiang, Xia, Pinglu, Ronghe, Wenxi, Ruicheng, and Yishi, the seven counties — the ground all quaked, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Pu and Jie prefectures and the seven counties of Jiang, Xia, Pinglu, Ronghe, Wenxi, Ruicheng, and Yishi all trembled with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 而安邑、萬全尤甚，民有壓死者。

translations.literal: At Anyi and Wanquan it was especially severe; among the people some were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Anyi and Wanquan the shaking was especially severe, and some civilians were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 正德元年二月癸酉至乙亥，觔陽地震者十餘，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, second month, from day guiyou to day yihai: at Jinyang there were more than ten quakes, with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, second month, from guiyou through yihai: Jinyang suffered more than ten earthquakes that sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 四月癸丑，雲南府連日再震。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guichou: Yunnan Prefecture quaked twice in succession over several days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guichou, Yunnan Prefecture shook twice in succession over several days.

sentences.zh: 木密關地震如雷凡五，壞城垣、屋舍，壓傷人。

translations.literal: At Mumi Pass the ground quaked like thunder five times in all, damaging city walls and houses and injuring people.
translations.idiomatic: At Mumi Pass the ground shook like thunder five times in all, damaging walls and dwellings and injuring people.

sentences.zh: 八月丁巳，萊州府鰲山衛地震，聲如雷，城垛壞，以後屢震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingsi: at Aoshan Guard in Laizhou Prefecture the ground was shaken by earthquake, the sound like thunder; the parapets were damaged, and afterward it quaked repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi, Aoshan Guard in Laizhou Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake that sounded like thunder; the battlements were damaged, and tremors recurred thereafter.

sentences.zh: 萊州自九月至十二月，地震四十五，俱有聲如雷。

translations.literal: From the ninth month to the twelfth month Laizhou had forty-five earthquakes, all with sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: From the ninth through the twelfth month Laizhou recorded forty-five earthquakes, each with thunderous rumbling.

sentences.zh: 二年九月庚午，雲南府安州、新興州三日連震，搖撼民居，人有死者。

translations.literal: Year 2, ninth month, day gengwu: Anzhou and Xinxing Prefecture in Yunnan quaked for three days in succession, shaking civilian dwellings; some people died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 2, on gengwu, Anzhou and Xinxing Prefecture in Yunnan shook for three days running, rocking houses; some people were killed.

sentences.zh: 四年三月甲寅，廣寧大興堡地陷，長四尺，寬三尺，深四丈餘。

translations.literal: Year 4, third month, day jiayin: at Daxing Fort in Guangning the ground sank in, four chi long, three chi wide, and more than four zhang deep.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 4, on jiayin, the ground at Daxing Fort in Guangning subsided into a pit four chi long, three chi wide, and more than four zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 五月己亥夜，武昌見碧光如電者六，有聲如雷，已而地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jihai, night: at Wuchang green light like lightning was seen six times, with sound like thunder; presently the ground quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of jihai in the fifth month, green flashes like lightning were seen six times at Wuchang, with thunderous sound, and then the earth shook.

sentences.zh: 六年四月乙未，楚雄地三日五震，至明年五月又連震十三日。

translations.literal: Year 6, fourth month, day yimao: at Chuxiong the ground quaked five times in three days; up to the fifth month of the next year it again quaked continuously for thirteen days.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 6, on yimao, Chuxiong shook five times in three days; by the fifth month of the following year tremors had continued for thirteen days more.

sentences.zh: 十月甲辰，大理府鄧川州、劍川州、洱海衛地震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiachen: Dengchuan and Jianchuan prefectures and Erhai Guard in Dali Prefecture were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jiachen, Dengchuan and Jianchuan prefectures and Erhai Guard in Dali Prefecture were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 鶴慶、劍川尤甚，壞城垣、房廨，人有壓死者。

translations.literal: At Heqing and Jianchuan it was especially severe; city walls and offices were damaged, and some people were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Heqing and Jianchuan the damage was especially severe: walls and government buildings collapsed, and some people were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊午，京師地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day wuwu: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuwu, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 保定、河間二府及八縣三衛，山東武定州，同日皆震。

translations.literal: Baoding and Hejian, the two prefectures, and eight counties and three guards; Wuding Prefecture in Shandong — all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Baoding and Hejian prefectures, eight counties and three guards, and Wuding Prefecture in Shandong all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 霸州連三日十九震。

translations.literal: Bazhou for three days had nineteen quakes.
translations.idiomatic: Over three days Bazhou suffered nineteen earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 七年五月壬子，楚雄府自是日至甲子，地連震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Year 7, fifth month, day renzi: from that day to jiazi at Chuxiong Prefecture the ground quaked continuously, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 7, from renzi through jiazi, Chuxiong Prefecture shook without pause, with thunderous rumbling.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，騰衝衛地震兩日，壞城樓、官民廨宇。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jisi: Tengchong Guard quaked for two days, damaging gate towers and official and civilian buildings.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, Tengchong Guard shook for two days, destroying gate towers and government and private buildings.

sentences.zh: 赤水涌出，田禾盡沒，死傷甚衆。

translations.literal: Red water gushed forth; field crops were entirely submerged; deaths and injuries were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: Red water burst out; crops were wholly inundated; casualties were very heavy.

sentences.zh: 八年十二月戊戌，成都、重慶二府，潼川、邛二州，地俱震。

translations.literal: Year 8, twelfth month, day wuxu: Chengdu and Chongqing, the two prefectures; Tongchuan and Qiong, the two prefectures — the ground all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 8, on wuxu, Chengdu and Chongqing prefectures and Tongchuan and Qiong prefectures all shook.

sentences.zh: 九年六月甲辰，鳳陽府地震有聲。

translations.literal: Year 9, sixth month, day jiachen: Fengyang Prefecture was shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 9, on jiachen, Fengyang Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，京師大震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day yisi: the capital was greatly shaken.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi, the capital was shaken by a major earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月壬辰，敘州府，太原府代、平、榆次等十州縣，大同府應州山陰、馬邑二縣，俱地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day renchen: Xuzhou Prefecture; Dai, Ping, and Yuci and the other ten prefectures and counties in Taiyuan Prefecture; Shanyin and Mayi in Ying Prefecture, Datong Prefecture — all quaked, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on renchen, Xuzhou Prefecture; Dai, Ping, Yuci, and nine other prefectures and counties in Taiyuan; and Shanyin and Mayi in Ying Prefecture, Datong, all trembled with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 十年五月壬辰，雲南趙州永寧衛地震，逾月不止，有一日二三十震者。

translations.literal: Year 10, fifth month, day renchen: at Yongning Guard in Zhao Prefecture, Yunnan, the ground quaked and for more than a month did not stop; on some days there were twenty or thirty quakes.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of year 10, on renchen, Yongning Guard in Zhao Prefecture, Yunnan, shook and did not cease for more than a month; on some days there were twenty or thirty tremors.

sentences.zh: 黑氣如霧，地裂水涌，壞城垣、官廨、民居不可勝計，死者數千人，傷倍之。

translations.literal: Black qi like mist; the ground split and water gushed up; city walls, government offices, and dwellings damaged beyond counting; those who died numbered several thousand, and the wounded were twice as many.
translations.idiomatic: Black vapor like fog spread; the earth cracked and water surged; walls, yamens, and houses were destroyed beyond count; several thousand died and the wounded were twice that number.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，大理府地震，至九月乙未，復大震四日。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day dingchou: Dali Prefecture was shaken by earthquake; up to ninth month, day yimao, it again quaked greatly for four days.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingchou, Dali Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake; by yimao in the ninth month it shook violently again for four days.

sentences.zh: 十一年八月戊辰，南京地震，武昌府亦震。

translations.literal: Year 11, eighth month, day wuchen: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake; Wuchang Prefecture also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 11, on wuchen, Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake, and Wuchang Prefecture shook as well.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未，楚雄、大理二府，蒙化、景東二衛俱震。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day jiwei: Chuxiong and Dali, the two prefectures; Menghua and Jingdong, the two guards — all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jiwei, Chuxiong and Dali prefectures and Menghua and Jingdong guards all shook.

sentences.zh: 十二年四月甲子，撫州府及餘干、豐城二縣，泉州府，俱地震。

translations.literal: Year 12, fourth month, day jiazi: Fuzhou Prefecture and Yugan and Fengcheng, the two counties; Quanzhou Prefecture — all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 12, on jiazi, Fuzhou Prefecture, Yugan and Fengcheng counties, and Quanzhou Prefecture all trembled.

sentences.zh: 浙江金鄉衛自是日至七月己丑，凡十有五震。

translations.literal: At Jinxiang Guard in Zhejiang, from that day to seventh month, day jichou, in all there were fifteen quakes.
translations.idiomatic: At Jinxiang Guard in Zhejiang, from that day through jichou in the seventh month, there were fifteen earthquakes in all.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，雲南新興州及通海、河西、 {山習}峨諸縣地震，壞城樓、房屋，民有壓死者。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuchen: Xinxing Prefecture in Yunnan and Tonghai, Hexi, and Xi'e and the other counties were shaken by earthquake, damaging gate towers and houses; among the people some were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuchen, Xinxing Prefecture in Yunnan and Tonghai, Hexi, Xi'e, and other counties were shaken by earthquakes that damaged gate towers and houses; some civilians were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，濟、青、登、萊四府地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jimao: Ji, Qing, Deng, and Lai, the four prefectures, were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jimao, Ji, Qing, Deng, and Lai prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是歲，泉州二月至六月，金華二月至七月，皆數震。

translations.literal: That year, from the second month to the sixth month Quanzhou, and from the second month to the seventh month Jinhua, each quaked repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: That year Quanzhou shook repeatedly from the second through the sixth month, and Jinhua from the second through the seventh.

sentences.zh: 十三年六月己巳，大理府及趙、鄧川二州，浪穹縣地震。

translations.literal: Year 13, sixth month, day jisi: Dali Prefecture and Zhao and Dengchuan, the two prefectures; Langqiong County — earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of year 13, on jisi, Dali Prefecture, Zhao and Dengchuan prefectures, and Langqiong County were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是日，蒙化府亦震。

translations.literal: That day, Menghua Prefecture also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On the same day Menghua Prefecture shook as well.

sentences.zh: 十月甲午、十一月癸卯，又震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day jiawu; eleventh month, day guimao: again quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the tenth month and guimao in the eleventh month it shook again.

sentences.zh: 十四年二月丁丑，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 14, second month, day dingchou: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 14, on dingchou, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 九月丙午，昌平州、宣府、開平等衛亦震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day bingwu: Changping Prefecture, Xuanfu, and Kaiping and the other guards also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingwu, Changping Prefecture, Xuanfu, and Kaiping and other guards shook as well.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，福、興、泉三府地震。

translations.literal: Day bingchen: Fu, Xing, and Quan, the three prefectures, were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Fu, Xing, and Quan prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十五年三月丙申，安寧、姚安、賓州、蒙化、鶴慶俱地震。

translations.literal: Year 15, third month, day bingshen: Anning, Yao'an, Bin Prefecture, Menghua, and Heqing all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 15, on bingshen, Anning, Yao'an, Bin Prefecture, Menghua, and Heqing all shook.

sentences.zh: 蒙化震二日，僕城垣、廬舍，民有壓死者。

translations.literal: At Menghua it quaked for two days; city walls and dwellings collapsed; among the people some were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: At Menghua tremors lasted two days; walls and houses collapsed, and some civilians were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 八月辛酉，景東衛地震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day xinyou: Jingdong Guard was shaken by earthquake, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinyou, Jingdong Guard was shaken by an earthquake that sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 搖僕城牆、廨宇，地多拆裂。

translations.literal: It shook and collapsed city walls and offices; the ground split open in many places.
translations.idiomatic: Walls and government buildings were rocked and ruined, and the ground cracked open in many places.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，濟南、東昌、開封地震。

translations.literal: Day yichou: Jinan, Dongchang, and Kaifeng were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Jinan, Dongchang, and Kaifeng were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年正月，南京、鳳陽、山東、河南、陝西地震。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 2, first month: Nanjing, Fengyang, Shandong, Henan, and Shaanxi were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 2, first month: earthquakes struck Nanjing, Fengyang, Shandong, Henan, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 七月壬申，浙江定海諸衛地震，城堞盡毀。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day renshen: Dinghai and the other guards in Zhejiang were shaken by earthquake; the parapets were entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renshen, Dinghai and other guards in Zhejiang were shaken by earthquakes that destroyed every battlement.

sentences.zh: 三年正月丙寅朔，兩畿、河南、山東、陝西同時地震。

translations.literal: Year 3, first month, day bingyin, new moon: the two capitals, Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi all quaked at the same time.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 3, new moon on bingyin, both capitals together with Henan, Shandong, and Shaanxi shook at once.

sentences.zh: 二月辛亥，蘇、常、鎮三府地震。

translations.literal: Second month, day xinhai: Su, Chang, and Zhen, the three prefectures, were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinhai, Su, Chang, and Zhen prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 是年，南京震者再。

translations.literal: That year, Nanjing quaked twice.
translations.idiomatic: That year Nanjing trembled twice.

sentences.zh: 四年八月癸卯，徐州、鳳陽一衛三州縣及懷慶、開封二府俱地震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month, day guimao: Xuzhou; one guard and three prefectures and counties of Fengyang; Huaiqing and Kaifeng, the two prefectures — all quaked, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 4, on guimao, Xuzhou; one guard and three prefectures and counties in Fengyang; and Huaiqing and Kaifeng prefectures all shook with thunderous rumbling.

sentences.zh: 九月壬申，鳳陽、徐州及開封二縣復震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day renshen: Fengyang, Xuzhou, and two counties in Kaifeng again quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renshen, Fengyang, Xuzhou, and two counties in Kaifeng shook again.

sentences.zh: 五年四月癸亥，永昌、騰衝、騰越同日地震。

translations.literal: Year 5, fourth month, day guihai: Yongchang, Tengchong, and Tengyue all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 5, on guihai, Yongchang, Tengchong, and Tengyue all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 貴州安南衛地震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: At Annan Guard in Guizhou the ground was shaken by earthquake, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: At Annan Guard in Guizhou the ground shook with thunderous rumbling.

sentences.zh: 壞城垣。

translations.literal: City walls were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: City walls were damaged.

sentences.zh: 壬申，復震。

translations.literal: Day renshen: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen it shook again.

sentences.zh: 六年十月戊辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 6, tenth month, day wuchen: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 6, on wuchen, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二年八月丁酉，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 12, eighth month, day dingyou: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of year 12, on dingyou, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十五年十月庚寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 15, tenth month, day gengyin: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of year 15, on gengyin, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 順天、永平、保定、萬全都司各衛所，俱震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Shuntian, Yongping, Baoding, and each guard and post of the Wanquan command — all quaked, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Shuntian, Yongping, Baoding, and every guard and station of the Wanquan command all trembled with thunderous rumbling.

sentences.zh: 十六年九月癸酉，雲南地震。

translations.literal: Year 16, ninth month, day guiyou: Yunnan was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 16, on guiyou, Yunnan was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十八年七月庚寅，楚雄、臨安、廣西地震。

translations.literal: Year 18, seventh month, day gengyin: Chuxiong, Lin'an, and Guangxi were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 18, on gengyin, Chuxiong, Lin'an, and Guangxi were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十九年四月庚午，洮州、甘肅俱震。

translations.literal: Year 19, fourth month, day gengwu: Tao and Gansu all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of year 19, on gengwu, Tao and Gansu both shook.

sentences.zh: 二十一年九月甲戌，平陽、固原、寧夏、洮州同日地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 21, ninth month, day jiaxu: Pingyang, Guyuan, Ningxia, and Tao all quaked on the same day, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 21, on jiaxu, Pingyang, Guyuan, Ningxia, and Tao all shook on the same day with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，鞏昌、固原、西安、鳳翔地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day dingsi: Gongchang, Guyuan, Xi'an, and Fengxiang were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingsi, Gongchang, Guyuan, Xi'an, and Fengxiang were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 二十二年三月乙巳，太原地震，有聲，凡十日。

translations.literal: Year 22, third month, day yisi: Taiyuan was shaken by earthquake, with sound; in all ten days.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of year 22, on yisi, Taiyuan was shaken by earthquakes with audible rumbling for ten days in all.

sentences.zh: 明年三月，復如之。

translations.literal: The next year, third month: again it was the same.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the following year it was the same again.

sentences.zh: 四月庚辰，福、興、泉、漳四府地震。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day gengchen: Fu, Xing, Quan, and Zhang, the four prefectures, were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on gengchen, Fu, Xing, Quan, and Zhang prefectures were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 二十三年三月朔，太原地震有聲者十日。

translations.literal: Year 23, third month, new moon: Taiyuan was shaken by earthquake with sound for ten days.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon of the third month of year 23, Taiyuan shook for ten days with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 二十七年七月戊寅，京師地震，順天、保定二府俱震。

translations.literal: Year 27, seventh month, day wuyin: the capital was shaken by earthquake; Shuntian and Baoding, the two prefectures, all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of year 27, on wuyin, the capital was shaken by an earthquake, and Shuntian and Baoding prefectures shook as well.

sentences.zh: 八月癸丑，京師復震，登州府及廣寧衛亦震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day guichou: the capital quaked again; Dengzhou Prefecture and Guangning Guard also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on guichou, the capital trembled again, and Dengzhou Prefecture and Guangning Guard shook too.

sentences.zh: 三十年九月乙未，京師地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 30, ninth month, day yiwei: the capital was shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year 30, on yiwei, the capital was shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 三十一年二月癸亥，鳳陽府地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 31, second month, day guihai: Fengyang Prefecture was shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of year 31, on guihai, Fengyang Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 三月丙戌，山西地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Third month, day bingxu: Shanxi was shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingxu, Shanxi was shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 三十四年十二月壬寅，山西、陝西、河南同時地震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Year 34, twelfth month, day renyin: Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Henan all quaked at the same time, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of year 34, on renyin, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Henan all shook at once with thunderous rumbling.

sentences.zh: 渭南、華州、朝邑、三原、蒲州等處尤甚。

translations.literal: Weinan, Huazhou, Chaoyi, Sanyuan, Puzhou, and other places were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Weinan, Huazhou, Chaoyi, Sanyuan, Puzhou, and other districts suffered especially severe damage.

sentences.zh: 或地裂泉涌，中有魚物，或城郭房屋，陷入地中，或平地突成山阜，或一日數震，或累日震不止。

translations.literal: In some places the ground split and springs gushed forth, with fish and creatures within; in some places city walls and houses sank into the ground; in some places level ground suddenly rose into hills; in some places there were several quakes in one day; in some places tremors continued for days without stopping.
translations.idiomatic: In some places the earth cracked and springs burst out bearing fish and other creatures; elsewhere walls and dwellings sank into the ground; level ground in places thrust up into hillocks; some locales shook several times in a single day, and others trembled for days on end.

sentences.zh: 河、渭大泛，華嶽、終南山鳴，河清數日。

translations.literal: The Yellow and Wei rivers flooded greatly; Mount Hua and the Qinling range rumbled; the rivers ran clear for several days.
translations.idiomatic: The Yellow and Wei rivers rose in great flood; Mount Hua and the Qinling peaks boomed; and the rivers ran clear for several days.

sentences.zh: 官吏、軍民壓死八十三萬有奇。

translations.literal: Officials, soldiers, and civilians crushed to death numbered more than eight hundred thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Officials, troops, and civilians crushed to death exceeded eight hundred thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 三十七年正月庚申，陝西地震。

translations.literal: Year 37, first month, day gengshen: Shaanxi was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year 37, on gengshen, Shaanxi was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 三月丁丑，昌平州地震。

translations.literal: Third month, day dingchou: Changping Prefecture was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingchou, Changping Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，蒲州地連震三日，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingmao: at Puzhou the ground shook continuously for three days, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 37, fifth month, dingmao: the ground at Puzhou shook continuously for three days with a sound like thunder.

sentences.zh: 六月甲申，又震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day jiashen: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 37, sixth month, jiashen: it shook again.

sentences.zh: 十月丙午，華州地震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day bingwu: Huazhou was shaken by earthquake, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 37, tenth month, bingwu: Huazhou was shaken by an earthquake that sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 至壬子又震，戊午復大震，傾陷廬舍甚多。

translations.literal: By renzi it quaked again; on wuwu there was again a great quake, and very many houses collapsed and sank.
translations.idiomatic: By renzi it shook again; on wuwu there was another great earthquake at Huazhou, and very many dwellings collapsed and sank.

sentences.zh: 三十八年七月辛巳，南京地震，有聲。

translations.literal: Year 38, seventh month, day xinsi: Nanjing was shaken by earthquake, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 38, seventh month, xinsi: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 三十九年四月，嘉興、湖州地震，屋廬搖動如帆。

translations.literal: Year 39, fourth month: at Jiaxing and Huzhou there were earthquakes; houses swayed like sails.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 39, fourth month: earthquakes at Jiaxing and Huzhou made houses sway like sails.

sentences.zh: 河水撞激，魚皆躍起。

translations.literal: River water struck and surged; all the fish leapt up.
translations.idiomatic: The river water struck and surged, and the fish all leapt up.

sentences.zh: 四十年二月戊戌，甘肅山丹衛地震，有聲，壞城堡廬舍。

translations.literal: Year 40, second month, day wuxu: at Gansu Shandan Guard there was an earthquake with sound; castles and houses were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 40, second month, wuxu: an earthquake with audible rumbling at Gansu Shandan Guard damaged castles and dwellings.

sentences.zh: 六月壬申，太原、大同、榆林地震，寧夏、固原尤甚。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day renshen: Taiyuan, Datong, and Yulin were shaken by earthquake; Ningxia and Guyuan were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen, Taiyuan, Datong, and Yulin were shaken by earthquakes; Ningxia and Guyuan suffered especially severely.

sentences.zh: 城垣、墩臺、府屋皆摧，地涌黑黃沙水，壓死軍民無算，壞廣武、紅寺等城。

translations.literal: City walls, signal towers, and government buildings were all destroyed; black and yellow sand and water gushed from the ground; soldiers and civilians crushed to death beyond count; Guangwu, Hongsi, and other cities were damaged.
translations.idiomatic: City walls, signal towers, and government buildings were all destroyed; black and yellow sand and water gushed from the ground; soldiers and civilians were crushed to death beyond count; and Guangwu, Hongsi, and other cities were wrecked.

sentences.zh: 四十一年正月丙申，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 41, first month, day bingshen: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 41, first month, bingshen: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是歲，寧夏地震，圮邊牆。

translations.literal: That year, Ningxia was shaken by earthquake; the border walls collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: That year Ningxia was shaken by an earthquake and the border walls collapsed.

sentences.zh: 四十五年正月癸巳，福建福、興、泉三府同日地震。

translations.literal: Year 45, first month, day guisi: in Fujian the three prefectures Fu, Xing, and Quan all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 45, first month, guisi: in Fujian the three prefectures of Fu, Xing, and Quan all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年三月甲寅，陝西慶陽、西安、漢中、寧夏，山西蒲州、安邑，湖廣鄖陽及河南十五州縣，同日地震。

translations.literal: Longqing year 2, third month, day jiayin: Qingyang, Xi'an, Hanzhong, and Ningxia in Shaanxi; Puzhou and Anyi in Shanxi; Yunyang in Huguang; and fifteen prefectures and counties in Henan all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2, third month, jiayin: Qingyang, Xi'an, Hanzhong, and Ningxia in Shaanxi; Puzhou and Anyi in Shanxi; Yunyang in Huguang; and fifteen prefectures and counties in Henan all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，京師地震。

translations.literal: Day wuyin: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2, wuyin: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 是日，山東登州、四川順義等縣同日震。

translations.literal: That day, Dengzhou in Shandong and Shunyi and other counties in Sichuan also quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: That day Dengzhou in Shandong and Shunyi and other counties in Sichuan shook as well.

sentences.zh: 樂亭地裂三丈餘者二，黑沙水涌出。

translations.literal: At Leting the ground split open in two places more than three zhang; black sand and water gushed forth.
translations.idiomatic: At Leting the ground split open in two places of more than three zhang each, and black sand and water gushed forth.

sentences.zh: 寧遠城崩。

translations.literal: Ningyuan city collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Ningyuan city collapsed.

sentences.zh: 四月癸未，懷慶、南陽、汝寧、寧夏同日地震。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day guiwei: Huaqing, Nanyang, Runing, and Ningxia all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on guiwei, Huaqing, Nanyang, Runing, and Ningxia all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，鳳翔、平涼、西安、慶陽地震，壞城傷人。

translations.literal: Day yiyou: Fengxiang, Pingliang, Xi'an, and Qingyang were shaken by earthquake; cities were damaged and people injured.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Fengxiang, Pingliang, Xi'an, and Qingyang were shaken by earthquakes that damaged cities and injured people.

sentences.zh: 七月辛酉，陵川地裂三十餘步。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day xinyou: at Lingchuan the ground split open for more than thirty bu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinyou, the ground at Lingchuan split open for more than thirty bu.

sentences.zh: 三年十一月庚辰，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 3, eleventh month, day gengchen: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 3, eleventh month, gengchen: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 四年四月戊戌，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, fourth month, day wuxu: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 4, fourth month, wuxu: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五年二月丙午，廣西靖江王府及宗室所居、布政司官署，俱地陷。

translations.literal: Year 5, second month, day bingwu: at the Jingjiang princely establishment in Guangxi, the residences of the imperial clan, and the offices of the provincial administration commission, the ground all sank.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 5, second month, bingwu: at the Jingjiang princely establishment in Guangxi, the residences of the imperial clan, and the offices of the provincial administration commission, the ground all sank.

sentences.zh: 六月辛卯朔，京師地震者三。

translations.literal: Sixth month, new moon on day xinmao: the capital was shaken by earthquake three times.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 5, sixth month, xinmao new moon: the capital was shaken by earthquakes three times.

sentences.zh: 萬曆元年八月戊申，荊州地震，至丙寅方止。

translations.literal: Wanli year 1, eighth month, day wushen: Jingzhou was shaken by earthquake; only on bingyin did it stop.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 1, eighth month, wushen: Jingzhou was shaken by an earthquake that did not cease until bingyin.

sentences.zh: 二年二月癸亥，長汀地震，裂成坑，陷沒民居。

translations.literal: Year 2, second month, day guihai: at Changting there was an earthquake; it split into pits and dwellings sank and were buried.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 2, second month, guihai: an earthquake at Changting split the ground into pits and buried dwellings.

sentences.zh: 三年二月甲戌，湖廣、江西地震。

translations.literal: Year 3, second month, day jiaxu: Huguang and Jiangxi were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 3, second month, jiaxu: Huguang and Jiangxi were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 五月戊戌朔，襄陽、鄖陽及南陽府屬地震三日。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon on day wuxu: Xiangyang, Yunyang, and the subordinate prefectures of Nanyang were shaken by earthquake for three days.
translations.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the fifth month Xiangyang, Yunyang, and the subordinate prefectures of Nanyang were shaken by earthquakes for three days.

sentences.zh: 己亥，信陽亦震。

translations.literal: Day jihai: Xinyang also quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Xinyang shook as well.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，福、汀、漳等府及廣東之海陽縣俱地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day wuzi: the prefectures of Fu, Ting, and Zhang and Haiyang County in Guangdong all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi, the prefectures of Fu, Ting, and Zhang and Haiyang County in Guangdong all shook.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，京師地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day wuwu: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月丁卯，又震。

translations.literal: Tenth month, day dingmao: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on dingmao, it shook again.

sentences.zh: 己卯，岷州衛地震。

translations.literal: Day jimao: Minzhou Guard was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Minzhou Guard was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 己丑至壬午，連百餘震。

translations.literal: From jichou to renwu there were more than a hundred quakes in succession.
translations.idiomatic: From jichou to renwu there were more than a hundred earthquakes in succession.

sentences.zh: 四年二月庚辰，薊、遼地震。

translations.literal: Year 4, second month, day gengchen: Ji and Liao were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 4, second month, gengchen: Ji and Liao were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，又震。

translations.literal: Day xinsi: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi it shook again.

sentences.zh: 五年二月辛巳，騰越地二十餘震，次日復震。

translations.literal: Year 5, second month, day xinsi: at Tengyue the ground quaked more than twenty times; the next day it quaked again.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 5, second month, xinsi: the ground at Tengyue quaked more than twenty times, and the next day it shook again.

sentences.zh: 山崩水涌，壞廟廡、倉舍千餘間，民居圮者十之七，壓死軍民甚衆。

translations.literal: Mountains collapsed and water surged; more than a thousand temple halls and granaries were damaged; seven-tenths of civilian dwellings collapsed; very many soldiers and civilians were crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Mountains collapsed and water surged; more than a thousand temple halls and granaries were wrecked; seven-tenths of civilian dwellings collapsed; and very many soldiers and civilians were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 六年二月辛卯，臨桂村田中青煙直上，隨裂地丈餘，鼓聲轟轟，民居及大樹石皆陷。

translations.literal: Year 6, second month, day xinmao: in a field at Lingui Village blue smoke shot straight up; presently the ground split open more than a zhang; drumlike sounds boomed; dwellings, great trees, and rocks all sank.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 6, second month, xinmao: in a field at Lingui Village blue smoke shot straight up; presently the ground split open more than a zhang with booming drumlike sounds, and dwellings, great trees, and rocks all sank.

sentences.zh: 七年七月戊午，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 7, seventh month, day wuwu: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 7, seventh month, wuwu: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 八年五月壬午，遵化數震，七日乃止。

translations.literal: Year 8, fifth month, day renwu: at Zunhua there were several quakes; only after seven days did they stop.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 8, fifth month, renwu: Zunhua suffered several earthquakes that did not cease until seven days had passed.

sentences.zh: 七月甲午，井坪路地大震，摧城垣數百丈。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiawu: at Jingping Route the ground was greatly shaken; several hundred zhang of city wall were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on jiawu, the ground at Jingping Route was violently shaken, destroying several hundred zhang of city wall.

sentences.zh: 九年四月己酉，蔚州地震，聲如雷。

translations.literal: Year 9, fourth month, day jiyou: Yu Prefecture was shaken by earthquake, the sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 9, fourth month, jiyou: Yu Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake that sounded like thunder.

sentences.zh: 房屋震裂。

translations.literal: Houses cracked from the shaking.
translations.idiomatic: Houses cracked from the shaking.

sentences.zh: 大同鎮堡各州縣，同時地震，有聲。

translations.literal: The various prefectures and counties of Datong garrison also quaked at the same time, with sound.
translations.idiomatic: The various prefectures and counties of Datong garrison also shook at the same time, with audible rumbling.

sentences.zh: 十一年二月戊子，承天府地震。

translations.literal: Year 11, second month, day wuzi: Cheng Prefecture was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 11, second month, wuzi: Cheng Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月丁卯，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 12, second month, day dingmao: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 12, second month, dingmao: the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，又震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day jiawu: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on jiawu, it shook again.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月丁未，淮安、揚州、廬州及上元、江寧、江浦、六合俱地震。

translations.literal: Year 13, second month, day dingwei: Huai'an, Yangzhou, Luzhou, and Shangyuan, Jiangning, Jiangpu, and Liuhe all quaked.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 13, second month, dingwei: Huai'an, Yangzhou, Luzhou, Shangyuan, Jiangning, Jiangpu, and Liuhe all shook.

sentences.zh: 江濤沸騰。

translations.literal: River waves seethed and boiled.
translations.idiomatic: River waves seethed and boiled.

sentences.zh: 三月戊寅，山西山陰縣地震，旬有五日乃止。

translations.literal: Third month, day wuyin: at Shanyin County in Shanxi there was an earthquake; only after fifteen days did it stop.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuyin, an earthquake at Shanyin County in Shanxi did not cease until fifteen days had passed.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，京師地震。

translations.literal: Eighth month, day jiyou: the capital was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jiyou, the capital was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月癸酉，又震。

translations.literal: Year 14, fourth month, day guiyou: again it quaked.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 14, fourth month, guiyou: it shook again.

sentences.zh: 十五年三月壬辰，開封府屬地震者三，彰德、衛輝、懷慶同日震。

translations.literal: Year 15, third month, day renchen: the subordinate prefectures of Kaifeng were shaken by earthquake three times; Zhangde, Weihui, and Huaqing all quaked on the same day.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 15, third month, renchen: the subordinate prefectures of Kaifeng were shaken by earthquakes three times; Zhangde, Weihui, and Huaqing all shook on the same day.

sentences.zh: 五月，山西地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month: Shanxi was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Shanxi was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十六年六月庚申，京師地再震。

translations.literal: Year 16, sixth month, day gengshen: the capital ground quaked twice.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 16, sixth month, gengshen: the capital trembled twice.

sentences.zh: 十七年七月己未，杭州、溫州、紹興地震。

translations.literal: Year 17, seventh month, day jiwei: Hangzhou, Wenzhou, and Shaoxing were shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 17, seventh month, jiwei: Hangzhou, Wenzhou, and Shaoxing were shaken by earthquakes.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月丙子，甘肅臨洮地震，壞城郭、廬舍，壓死人畜無算。

translations.literal: Year 18, sixth month, day bingzi: at Gansu Lintao there was an earthquake; city walls and houses were damaged; people and livestock crushed to death beyond count.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 18, sixth month, bingzi: an earthquake at Gansu Lintao damaged city walls and dwellings and crushed people and livestock beyond count.

sentences.zh: 八月，福建地屢震。

translations.literal: Eighth month: in Fujian the ground quaked repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the ground in Fujian quaked repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 十九年閏三月己巳，昌平州地震。

translations.literal: Year 19, intercalary third month, day jisi: Changping Prefecture was shaken by earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 19, intercalary third month, jisi: Changping Prefecture was shaken by an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 十月戊戌，山丹衛地震，壞城垣。
