translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 11, ninth month, renxu: earthquake in Liaodong.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月癸巳，京師地震。

translations.literal: Year 12, second month, day guisi: capital earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 12, second month, guisi: earthquake at the capital.

sentences.zh: 十三年十一月戊子，南京地震。

translations.literal: Year 13, eleventh month, day wuzi: Nanjing earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13, eleventh month, wuzi: earthquake at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 十四年三月戊寅，福建地震。

translations.literal: Year 14, third month, day wuyin: Fujian earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14, third month, wuyin: earthquake in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 四月丙寅，湖廣地震。

translations.literal: Fourth month, day bingyin: Huguang earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth month, bingyin: earthquake in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 五月戊子，甘肅地震。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day wuzi: Gansu earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, wuzi: earthquake in Gansu.

sentences.zh: 六月丙午，福建地震。

translations.literal: Sixth month, day bingwu: Fujian earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month, bingwu: earthquake in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 九月甲午，四川地震。

translations.literal: Ninth month, day jiawu: Sichuan earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, jiawu: earthquake in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月丙戌，兩廣地震。

translations.literal: Year 15, fifth month, day bingxu: Guangdong and Guangxi earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 15, fifth month, bingxu: earthquake in Guangdong and Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 七月甲申，山西地震。

translations.literal: Seventh month, day jiashen: Shanxi earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh month, jiashen: earthquake in Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 十六年九月，鳳陽地屢震。

translations.literal: Year 16, ninth month: Fengyang ground quaked repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 16, ninth month: the ground at Fengyang shook repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙申，山東地震。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, day bingshen: Shandong earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Eleventh month, bingshen: earthquake in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 明年正月庚寅朔，鳳陽地震。

translations.literal: The following year, first month, day gengyin new moon: Fengyang earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, first month, gengyin new moon: earthquake at Fengyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，南京地震。

translations.literal: Day yimao: Nanjing earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Yimao: earthquake at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 三月辛卯，廣東地震。

translations.literal: Third month, day xinmao: Guangdong earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: Third month, xinmao: earthquake in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: ▲山頹

translations.literal: ▲ Mountain collapse.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Mountain Collapse

sentences.zh: 洪武六年正月壬戌夜，伏羌高山崩。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 6, first month, day renxu night: at Fuxiang a high mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 6, first month, renxu night: a high mountain at Fuxiang collapsed.

sentences.zh: 正統八年十一月，浙江紹興山移於平田。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 8, eleventh month: in Zhejiang Shaoxing a mountain moved onto level fields.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 8, eleventh month: in Shaoxing, Zhejiang, a mountain shifted onto level fields.

sentences.zh: 是歲，陝西二處山崩。

translations.literal: That year, two places in Shaanxi had mountains collapse.
translations.idiomatic: That year mountains collapsed in two places in Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 十三年，陝西夏秋霪雨，通渭、平涼、華亭三縣山傾，軍民壓死者八十餘口。

translations.literal: Year 13: in Shaanxi summer and autumn continuous rain; in Tongwei, Pingliang, and Huating three counties mountains slumped; over eighty soldiers and civilians crushed to death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 13: in Shaanxi continuous rain through summer and autumn caused mountains to slump in Tongwei, Pingliang, and Huating; more than eighty soldiers and civilians were crushed to death.

sentences.zh: 天順四年十月，星子山裂。

translations.literal: Tianshun year 4, tenth month: Xingzi Mountain split open.
translations.idiomatic: Tianshun 4, tenth month: Xingzi Mountain split open.

sentences.zh: 成化八年七月，隴州北山吼三日，裂成溝，長半里，尋復合。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 8, seventh month: at Longzhou the north mountain roared three days; split into a ditch half a li long; soon closed again.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 8, seventh month: the north mountain at Longzhou roared for three days, split into a ditch half a li long, then soon closed again.

sentences.zh: 十六年四月壬子，巨津州金沙江北岸白石雪山斷裂里許，兩岸山合，山上草木如故。

translations.literal: Year 16, fourth month, day renzi: at Jujinzhou on the north bank of the Jinsha River west of Baishi, Snow Mountain cracked apart for over a li; mountains on both banks joined; vegetation on the mountain as before.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 16, fourth month, renzi: at Jujinzhou on the north bank of the Jinsha River west of Baishi, Snow Mountain cracked apart for more than a li and the mountains on both banks came together, yet the vegetation on the mountain remained as before.

sentences.zh: 下塞江流，禾黍盡沒。

translations.literal: Below it blocked the river flow; grain crops all submerged.
translations.idiomatic: Below it the river was blocked and grain crops were all submerged.

sentences.zh: 久之其下漸開，水始泄。

translations.literal: After a long time the blockage below gradually opened; water began to drain.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time the blockage below gradually opened and the water began to drain.

sentences.zh: 六月，長樂平地出小阜，人畜踐之輒陷。

translations.literal: Sixth month: at Changle on level ground a small mound appeared; men and livestock stepping on it would sink.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth month: on level ground at Changle a small mound appeared, and men and livestock that stepped on it sank in.

sentences.zh: 明年，復涌一高山。

translations.literal: The following year, a high mountain gushed up again.
translations.idiomatic: The following year a high mountain surged up again.

sentences.zh: 十七年十二月辛丑，壽陽縣城南山崩，聲如牛吼。

translations.literal: Year 17, twelfth month, day xinchou: south of Shouyang County city a mountain collapsed; sound like ox roaring.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 17, twelfth month, xinchou: south of Shouyang county seat a mountain collapsed with a sound like oxen roaring.

sentences.zh: 弘治三年六月乙巳，河州山崩地陷。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 3, sixth month, day yisi: at Hezhou mountain collapse and ground subsidence.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 3, sixth month, yisi: at Hezhou a mountain collapsed and the ground subsided.

sentences.zh: 九年六月庚寅，山陰、蕭山二縣同日大雨山崩。

translations.literal: Year 9, sixth month, day gengyin: Shanyin and Xiaoshan two counties same day great rain mountain collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 9, sixth month, gengyin: in Shanyin and Xiaoshan the same day heavy rain brought mountain collapse.

sentences.zh: 十四年閏七月，烏撒軍民府大雨山崩。

translations.literal: Year 14, intercalary seventh month: at Wusa Military-Civilian Prefecture great rain mountain collapse.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 14, intercalary seventh month: at Wusa Military-Civilian Prefecture heavy rain brought mountain collapse.

sentences.zh: 十五年八月戊申，宣府合河口石山崩。

translations.literal: Year 15, eighth month, day wushen: at Xuanfu Hehekou stone mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 15, eighth month, wushen: the stone mountain at Hehekou in Xuanfu collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十八年六月丙子，河州沙子溝夜大雷雨，石岸山崩，移七八里，崩處裂爲溝，田廬民畜俱陷。

translations.literal: Year 18, sixth month, day bingzi: at Hezhou Shazigou night great thunderstorm; stone cliff mountain collapsed, moved seven or eight li; collapse site split into ditch; fields, dwellings, people and livestock all sank.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 18, sixth month, bingzi: at Shazigou in Hezhou a night of great thunder and rain collapsed a stone-cliff mountain that shifted seven or eight li; the collapse site split into a ditch, and fields, dwellings, people, and livestock all sank in.

sentences.zh: 正德元年十二月癸亥，即墨三表山石崩。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 1, twelfth month, day guihai: at Jimo Sanbiao Mountain stone collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 1, twelfth month, guihai: stone collapsed from Sanbiao Mountain at Jimo.

sentences.zh: 四年三月甲寅，遼東東山大家峪山崩二處，約丈餘。

translations.literal: Year 4, third month, day jiayin: in Liaodong at Dajia Valley on Eastern Mountain two mountain collapses, about ten-odd chi.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 4, third month, jiayin: in Liaodong at Dajia Valley on Eastern Mountain there were two mountain collapses of about ten-odd chi each.

sentences.zh: 五年六月癸巳，秦州山崩，傷室廬、禾稼甚衆。

translations.literal: Year 5, sixth month, day guisi: at Qinzhou mountain collapsed; many dwellings and crops injured.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 5, sixth month, guisi: a mountain at Qinzhou collapsed, damaging many dwellings and crops.

sentences.zh: 龍王溝口山亦崩。

translations.literal: At Longwangkou mountain also collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain at Longwangkou also collapsed.

sentences.zh: 六年七月丙寅，夔州麞子溪驟雨，山崩。

translations.literal: Year 6, seventh month, day bingyin: at Kuizhou Zhangzi Stream sudden rain, mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 6, seventh month, bingyin: at Zhangzi Stream in Kuizhou sudden rain brought mountain collapse.

sentences.zh: 十三年五月癸亥，雲南黑鹽井山崩，井塞。

translations.literal: Year 13, fifth month, day guihai: Yunnan Heiyan Well mountain collapsed; well blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 13, fifth month, guihai: at Heiyan Well in Yunnan a mountain collapsed and blocked the well.

sentences.zh: 十五年八月丁丑，雲南趙州大雨，山崩。

translations.literal: Year 15, eighth month, day dingchou: Yunnan Zhao Prefecture great rain, mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 15, eighth month, dingchou: at Zhao Prefecture in Yunnan heavy rain brought mountain collapse.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖四年七月乙酉，清源賈家山崩。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 4, seventh month, day youwei: Qingyuan Jia Family Mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 4, seventh month, youwei: Jia Family Mountain at Qingyuan collapsed.

sentences.zh: 五年四月壬申，貴州歹蘇屯山崩。

translations.literal: Year 5, fourth month, day renshen: Guizhou Daisu Stockade mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 5, fourth month, renshen: a mountain at Daisu Stockade in Guizhou collapsed.

sentences.zh: 十九年十二月己巳，峨眉宋皇觀山鳴，震裂，涌泉水八日。

translations.literal: Year 19, twelfth month, day jisi: at Emei Song Emperor Observatory Mountain rang; cracked and shook; spring water gushed forth for eight days.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 19, twelfth month, jisi: Song Emperor Observatory Mountain at Emei rang, cracked, and shook, and spring water gushed forth for eight days.

sentences.zh: 二十一年六月乙酉，歸州沙子嶺大雷雨，崖石崩裂，塞江流二里許。

translations.literal: Year 21, sixth month, day youwei: at Guizhou Shaziling great thunderstorm; cliff stones collapsed and split; blocked river flow for over two li.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 21, sixth month, youwei: at Shaziling in Guizhou a great thunderstorm collapsed and split cliff stones, blocking the river for more than two li.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月癸酉，澄城麻陂山界頭嶺，晝夜吼數日。

translations.literal: Year 26, seventh month, day guiyou: at Chengcheng Mabo Mountain Jietou Ridge roared day and night for several days.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 26, seventh month, guiyou: at Jietou Ridge on Mabo Mountain in Chengcheng there was roaring day and night for several days.

sentences.zh: 山忽中斷，移走，東西三里，南北五里。

translations.literal: Mountain suddenly broke in the middle, moved away—three li east-west, five li north-south.
translations.idiomatic: The mountain suddenly broke apart in the middle and shifted away three li east to west and five li north to south.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年五月庚戌，永寧州山崩。

translations.literal: Longqing year 2, fifth month, day gengxu: Yongning Prefecture mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2, fifth month, gengxu: a mountain at Yongning Prefecture collapsed.

sentences.zh: 是歲，樂亭地裂三處，俱涌黑沙水。

translations.literal: That year, at Leting ground split in three places; all gushed black sandy water.
translations.idiomatic: That year at Leting the ground split open in three places, all gushing black sandy water.

sentences.zh: 四年八月，湖州山崩，成湖。

translations.literal: Year 4, eighth month: at Huzhou mountain collapsed, forming a lake.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 4, eighth month: a mountain at Huzhou collapsed and formed a lake.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十五年六月，泰山崩。

translations.literal: Wanli year 25, sixth month: Mount Tai collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 25, sixth month: Mount Tai collapsed.

sentences.zh: 二十七年八月甲午，狄道城東山崩，其下衝成一溝。

translations.literal: Year 27, eighth month, day jiawu: east of Didao city mountain collapsed; below it a ditch was gouged out.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 27, eighth month, jiawu: east of Didao city a mountain collapsed, gouging out a ditch below.

sentences.zh: 山南耕地涌出大小山五，高二十餘丈。

translations.literal: South of the mountain cultivated land spewed out five mountains large and small, twenty-odd zhang high.
translations.idiomatic: South of the mountain, cultivated land spewed out five mountains large and small, more than twenty zhang high.

sentences.zh: 三十三年八月丙午，鎮江西南華山裂二三尺。

translations.literal: Year 33, eighth month, day bingwu: at Zhenjiang southwest Hua Mountain cracked two or three chi.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 33, eighth month, bingwu: Hua Mountain southwest of Zhenjiang cracked two or three chi.

sentences.zh: 三十七年六月辛酉，甘肅南山崩。

translations.literal: Year 37, sixth month, day xinyou: Gansu south mountain collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 37, sixth month, xinyou: a mountain in southern Gansu collapsed.

sentences.zh: 天啓三年閏十月乙卯，仁壽長山聲震如雷，裂七里，寬三尺，深不可測。

translations.literal: Tianqi year 3, intercalary tenth month, day yimao: at Renshou Chang Mountain sound shook like thunder; split seven li, three chi wide, depth immeasurable.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi 3, intercalary tenth month, yimao: at Chang Mountain in Renshou the sound shook like thunder; it split seven li, three chi wide, and to an immeasurable depth.

sentences.zh: 崇禎九年十二月，鎮江金雞嶺土山崩。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 9, twelfth month: at Zhenjiang Golden Cock Ridge an earthen hill collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 9, twelfth month: an earthen hill at Zhenjiang's Golden Cock Ridge collapsed.

sentences.zh: 後八年，秦州有二山，相距甚遠，民居其間者數百萬家。

translations.literal: Eight years later, at Qinzhou there were two mountains very far apart, with several million households of common people dwelling between them.
translations.idiomatic: Eight years later, at Qin Prefecture two mountains stood far apart, with several million households dwelling between them.

sentences.zh: 一日地震，兩山合，居民併入其中。

translations.literal: One day there was an earthquake; the two mountains joined together, and the inhabitants were merged into them.
translations.idiomatic: One day an earthquake struck; the two mountains closed together and the inhabitants were engulfed within them.

sentences.zh: ▲雨毛、地生毛

translations.literal: ▲ Feather rain and ground growing hair.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Feather Rain and Hair Growing from the Ground

sentences.zh: 洪武十九年九月丙子，天雨絮。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 19, ninth month, day bingzi: the sky rained floss.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 19, ninth month, day bingzi: floss rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年七月甲午，地生毛，長尺餘。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1, seventh month, day jiawu: the ground grew hair more than a chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1, seventh month, day jiawu: hair grew from the ground more than a chi long.

sentences.zh: 正統八年，浙江地生白毛。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 8: Zhejiang's ground grew white hair.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 8: white hair grew from the ground in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 成化十三年四月，甘肅地裂，生白毛。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 13, fourth month: Gansu split open and white hair grew.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 13, fourth month: the ground split open in Gansu and white hair grew forth.

sentences.zh: 十五年五月，常州地生白毛。

translations.literal: Year 15, fifth month: Changzhou's ground grew white hair.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 15, fifth month: white hair grew from the ground at Changzhou.

sentences.zh: 十七年四月，南京地生白毛。

translations.literal: Year 17, fourth month: Nanjing's ground grew white hair.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 17, fourth month: white hair grew from the ground at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 弘治元年五月丙寅，瀘州長寧縣雨毛。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 1, fifth month, day bingyin: Changning County in Luzhou rained hair.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 1, fifth month, day bingyin: hair rained at Changning County in Luz Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 正德十二年四月，金華地生黑白毛，長尺餘。

translations.literal: Zhengde year 12, fourth month: Jinhua's ground grew black and white hair more than a chi long.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde 12, fourth month: black and white hair more than a chi long grew from the ground at Jinhua.

sentences.zh: ▲年飢

translations.literal: ▲ Year famine.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Years of Famine

sentences.zh: 洪武二年，湖廣、陝西飢。

translations.literal: Hongwu year 2: Huguang and Shaanxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 2: famine struck Huguang and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 四年，陝西洊飢。

translations.literal: Year 4: Shaanxi famine again.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 4: Shaanxi suffered famine again.

sentences.zh: 五年，濟南、東昌、萊州大飢，草實樹皮，食爲之盡。

translations.literal: Year 5: Jinan, Dongchang, and Laizhou great famine; grass seeds and tree bark were all consumed as food.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 5: a great famine gripped Jinan, Dongchang, and Laizhou; grass seeds and tree bark were eaten until nothing remained.

sentences.zh: 六年，蘇州、揚州、真定、延安飢。

translations.literal: Year 6: Suzhou, Yangzhou, Zhending, and Yan'an famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 6: famine struck Suzhou, Yangzhou, Zhending, and Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 七年，北平所屬州縣三十三飢。

translations.literal: Year 7: thirty-three prefectures and counties subordinate to Beiping famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 7: thirty-three prefectures and counties under Beiping suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 十五年，河南飢。

translations.literal: Year 15: Henan famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 15: famine in Henan.

sentences.zh: 十九年春，河南飢。

translations.literal: Year 19, spring: Henan famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 19, spring: famine in Henan.

sentences.zh: 夏，青州飢。

translations.literal: Summer: Qingzhou famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 19, summer: famine in Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十年，山東三府飢。

translations.literal: Year 20: the three prefectures of Shandong famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 20: famine struck the three prefectures of Shandong.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，湖廣三府、二州飢。

translations.literal: Year 23: three prefectures and two subprefectures of Huguang famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 23: famine struck three prefectures and two subprefectures in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，山東及太原飢，徐、沛民食草實。

translations.literal: Year 24: Shandong and Taiyuan famine; the people of Xu and Pei ate grass seeds.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 24: famine in Shandong and Taiyuan; the people of Xu and Pei ate grass seeds.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，山東洊飢。

translations.literal: Year 25: Shandong famine again.
translations.idiomatic: Hongwu 25: Shandong suffered famine again.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年，北畿飢。

translations.literal: Hongxi year 1: the northern metropolitan region famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxi 1: famine in the northern metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 山東、河南、湖廣及南畿州縣三十四飢。

translations.literal: Shandong, Henan, Huguang, and thirty-four prefectures and counties of the southern metropolitan region famine.
translations.idiomatic: Hongxi 1: famine also struck Shandong, Henan, Huguang, and thirty-four prefectures and counties of the southern metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，直省州縣二十九飢。

translations.literal: Xuande year 1: twenty-nine prefectures and counties of the directly administered provinces famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 1: twenty-nine prefectures and counties in the directly administered provinces suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 二年，直省縣十四飢。

translations.literal: Year 2: fourteen counties of the directly administered provinces famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 2: fourteen counties in the directly administered provinces suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 三年，直省州縣十五飢。

translations.literal: Year 3: fifteen prefectures and counties of the directly administered provinces famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 3: fifteen prefectures and counties in the directly administered provinces suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 六年直省縣十飢。

translations.literal: Year 6: ten counties of the directly administered provinces famine.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 6: ten counties in the directly administered provinces suffered famine.

sentences.zh: 八年，以水旱告飢者，府州縣七十有六。

translations.literal: Year 8: seventy-six prefectures, subprefectures, and counties reported famine from flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 8: seventy-six prefectures, subprefectures, and counties reported famine from flood and drought.

sentences.zh: 九年，南畿、山東、浙江、陝西、山西、江西、四川多告飢，湖廣尤甚。

translations.literal: Year 9: the southern metropolitan region, Shandong, Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Jiangxi, and Sichuan widely reported famine; Huguang was especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Xuande 9: the southern metropolitan region, Shandong, Zhejiang, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Jiangxi, and Sichuan widely reported famine; Huguang was worst hit.

sentences.zh: 十年，揚、徐、滁、南昌大飢。

translations.literal: Year 10: Yang, Xu, Chuzhou, and Nanchang great famine.

translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 45: famine in Huai'an and Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，蘇、鬆二府大飢。

translations.literal: Longqing year 1: the two prefectures of Suzhou and Songjiang great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 1: a great famine struck the prefectures of Suzhou and Songjiang.

sentences.zh: 二年，湖廣飢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Huguang famine.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 2: famine in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 崇禎元年，陝西飢，延、鞏民相聚爲盜。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 1: Shaanxi famine; the people of Yan'an and Gongchang gathered together as bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 1: famine in Shaanxi; the people of Yan'an and Gongchang banded together as robbers.

sentences.zh: 二年，山西、陝西飢。

translations.literal: Year 2: Shanxi and Shaanxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 2: famine in Shanxi and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 五年，淮、揚諸府飢，流殍載道。

translations.literal: Year 5: the various prefectures of Huai and Yang famine; famine victims filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 5: famine struck the Huai–Yang prefectures; the destitute dead and dying clogged the highways.

sentences.zh: 六年，陝西、山西大飢。

translations.literal: Year 6: Shaanxi and Shanxi great famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 6: a great famine struck Shaanxi and Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 淮、揚洊飢，有夫妻雉經於樹及投河者。

translations.literal: Huai and Yang famine again; there were husbands and wives who hanged themselves from trees or threw themselves into rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 6: Huai'an and Yangzhou suffered famine again; some couples hanged themselves from trees or drowned in the rivers.

sentences.zh: 鹽城教官王明佐至自縊於官署。

translations.literal: Yancheng education officer Wang Mingzuo arrived and hanged himself in the government office.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 6: Wang Mingzuo, an education officer at Yancheng, came to his post and hanged himself in the yamen.

sentences.zh: 七年，京師飢，御史龔廷獻繪《饑民圖》以進。

translations.literal: Year 7: the capital famine; censor Gong Tingxian painted the "Picture of Famine Victims" and presented it.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 7: famine at the capital; Censor Gong Tingxian painted the Picture of Famine Victims and submitted it to the throne.

sentences.zh: 太原大飢，人相食。

translations.literal: Taiyuan great famine; men ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 7: a great famine struck Taiyuan; people ate one another.

sentences.zh: 九年，南陽大飢，有母烹其女者。

translations.literal: Year 9: Nanyang great famine; there was a mother who cooked her daughter.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 9: a great famine struck Nanyang; one mother boiled and ate her own daughter.

sentences.zh: 江西亦飢。

translations.literal: Jiangxi also famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 9: Jiangxi suffered famine as well.

sentences.zh: 十年，浙江大飢，父子、兄弟、夫妻相食。

translations.literal: Year 10: Zhejiang great famine; fathers and sons, brothers, and husbands and wives ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 10: a great famine struck Zhejiang; fathers and sons, brothers, and husbands and wives ate one another.

sentences.zh: 十二年，兩畿、山東、山西、陝西、江西飢。

translations.literal: Year 12: both metropolitan regions, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Jiangxi famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 12: famine in both metropolitan regions, Shandong, Shanxi, Shaanxi, and Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 河南大飢，人相食，盧氏、嵩、伊陽三縣尤甚。

translations.literal: Henan great famine; men ate one another; the three counties of Lushi, Song, and Yiyang were especially severe.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 12: a great famine struck Henan; people ate one another, and the counties of Lushi, Song, and Yiyang were worst hit.

sentences.zh: 十三年，北畿、山東、河南、陝西、山西、浙江、三吳皆飢。

translations.literal: Year 13: the northern metropolitan region, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Zhejiang, and the Three Wu all famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13: famine struck the northern metropolitan region, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, Shanxi, Zhejiang, and the Three Wu region alike.

sentences.zh: 自淮而北至畿南，樹皮食盡，發瘞胔以食。

translations.literal: From the Huai River north to the south of the metropolitan region, tree bark was eaten clean; the buried dead were dug up for food.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 13: from the Huai northward to the southern reaches of the metropolitan region, tree bark was stripped bare; people exhumed buried corpses to eat.

sentences.zh: 十四年，南畿飢。

translations.literal: Year 14: the southern metropolitan region famine.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14: famine in the southern metropolitan region.

sentences.zh: 金壇民於延慶寺近山見人云，此地深入尺餘，其土可食。

translations.literal: At Jintan the people, near Yanqing Temple in the hills, saw someone say that a place here more than a chi deep had earth that could be eaten.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14: at Jintan, near Yanqing Temple in the hills, the people heard that earth more than a chi below the surface there was edible.

sentences.zh: 如言取之，淘磨爲粉粥而食，取者日衆。

translations.literal: As told they took it, washed and ground it into flour porridge and ate it; those who took it grew daily in number.
translations.idiomatic: They dug as directed, washed and ground the soil into a flour gruel and ate it; the number of gatherers grew each day.

sentences.zh: 又長山十里亦出土，堪食，其色青白類茯苓。

translations.literal: Again at Changshan, ten li away, earth also emerged that could be eaten; its color was blue-white like poria.
translations.idiomatic: Earth that could be eaten also appeared ten li away at Changshan; it was blue-white, resembling poria fungus.

sentences.zh: 又石子澗土黃赤，狀如豬肝，俗呼「觀音粉」，食之多腹痛隕墜，卒枕藉以死。

translations.literal: Again at Shizi Brook the earth was yellow-red, shaped like pig liver; commonly called "Guanyin flour," eating much of it caused belly pain and collapse; they died piled upon one another.
translations.idiomatic: At Shizi Brook the soil was yellow-red and liver-shaped; folk called it "Guanyin flour." Those who ate much suffered griping pains and collapsed; corpses lay heaped where they fell.

sentences.zh: 是歲，畿南、山東洊飢。

translations.literal: This year the south of the metropolitan region and Shandong famine again.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14: the southern metropolitan region and Shandong suffered famine again that year.

sentences.zh: 德州斗米千錢，父子相食，行人斷絕。

translations.literal: At Dezhou a dou of rice cost a thousand cash; fathers and sons ate one another, and travelers ceased entirely.
translations.idiomatic: At Dezhou a dou of rice sold for a thousand cash; fathers and sons ate one another, and traffic on the roads died away.

sentences.zh: 大盜滋矣。

translations.literal: Great banditry flourished.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14: large-scale banditry spread widely.

sentences.zh: ▲黃眚黃祥

translations.literal: ▲ Yellow afflictions and yellow omens.
translations.idiomatic: ▲ Yellow Afflictions and Yellow Omens

sentences.zh: 正統十一年二月辛酉，有異氣現華蓋殿金頂及奉天殿鴟吻之上。

translations.literal: Zhengtong year 11, second month, day xinyou: strange vapors appeared on the golden apex of Huagai Hall and above the roof-ridge ornaments of Fengtian Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengtong 11, second month, xinyou: an uncanny mist appeared on the gilded summit of Huagai Hall and above the chiwen ornaments of Fengtian Hall.

sentences.zh: 成化九年四月乙亥，兩京雨土。

translations.literal: Chenghua year 9, fourth month, day yihai: both capitals rained earth.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 9, fourth month, yihai: earth rained on both capitals.

sentences.zh: 十三年四月戊戌，陝西、甘肅冰厚五尺，間以雜沙，有青紅黃黑四色。

translations.literal: Year 13, fourth month, day wuxu: Shaanxi and Gansu ice five chi thick, mixed with sand, in blue, red, yellow, and black.
translations.idiomatic: Chenghua 13, fourth month, wuxu: in Shaanxi and Gansu ice lay five chi thick, interleaved with sand in blue, red, yellow, and black.

sentences.zh: 弘治十年三月己酉，雨土。

translations.literal: Hongzhi year 10, third month, day jiyou: rained earth.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 10, third month, jiyou: earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十一年四月辛巳，雨土。

translations.literal: Year 11, fourth month, day xinsi: rained earth.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 11, fourth month, xinsi: earth rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十七年二月甲辰，鄖陽、均州雨沙。

translations.literal: Year 17, second month, day jiachen: Yunyang and Junzhou rained sand.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzhi 17, second month, jiachen: sand rained at Yunyang and Junzhou.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖元年正月丁卯，雨黃沙。

translations.literal: Jiajing year 1, first month, day dingmao: yellow sand rained.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 1, first month, dingmao: yellow sand rained from the sky.

sentences.zh: 十三年二月己未，雨微土。

translations.literal: Year 13, second month, day jiwei: slight earth rained.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 13, second month, jiwei: a light fall of earth rained down.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，象山雨黃霧，行人口耳皆塞。

translations.literal: Year 21: at Xiangshan yellow mist rained; travelers' mouths and ears were all blocked.
translations.idiomatic: Jiajing 21: yellow mist fell like rain at Xiangshan; wayfarers' mouths and ears were choked shut.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年三月甲寅，南鄭雨土。

translations.literal: Longqing year 1, third month, day jiayin: Nanzheng rained earth.
translations.idiomatic: Longqing 1, third month, jiayin: earth rained at Nanzheng.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二十五年二月癸亥，湖州雨黃沙。

translations.literal: Wanli year 25, second month, day guihai: Huzhou rained yellow sand.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 25, second month, guihai: yellow sand rained at Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 四十六年三月庚午，暮刻，雨土，濛濛如霧如霰，入夜不止。

translations.literal: Year 46, third month, day gengwu: at the dusk watch earth rained, dense like mist and hail, continuing through the night without cease.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 46, third month, gengwu: at the dusk watch earth fell like a thick mist and hail, and did not stop through the night.

sentences.zh: 四十七年二月甲戌，從未至酉，塵沙漲天，其色赤黃。

translations.literal: Year 47, second month, day jiaxu: from the wei hour to the you hour dust and sand filled the sky, its color red-yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 47, second month, jiaxu: from the wei hour until you, dust and sand blotted the sky in a red-yellow hue.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，山東省城及泰安、肥城皆雨土。

translations.literal: Year 48: the provincial capital of Shandong and Tai'an and Feicheng all rained earth.
translations.idiomatic: Wanli 48: earth rained on the Shandong provincial capital, Tai'an, and Feicheng.

sentences.zh: 崇禎十二年二月壬申，浚縣有黑黃雲起，旋分爲二。

translations.literal: Chongzhen year 12, second month, day renshen: at Jun County black and yellow clouds rose, then quickly split in two.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 12, second month, renshen: at Jun County black and yellow clouds arose and swiftly divided in two.

sentences.zh: 頃之四塞。

translations.literal: In a moment all four sides were filled.
translations.idiomatic: In an instant the sky closed in on every side.

sentences.zh: 狂風大作，黃埃漲天，間以青白氣。

translations.literal: A violent wind arose; yellow dust filled the sky, mixed with blue-white vapors.
translations.idiomatic: A fierce gale sprang up; yellow dust flooded the heavens, streaked with blue-white haze.

sentences.zh: 五步之外，不辨人蹤，至昏始定。

translations.literal: Beyond five paces human tracks could not be distinguished; it only settled at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond five paces one could not tell a human form; calm returned only at nightfall.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月壬寅，黃埃漲天。

translations.literal: Year 14, first month, day renyin: yellow dust filled the sky.
translations.idiomatic: Chongzhen 14, first month, renyin: yellow dust filled the sky.
